ep4.「皆まで言わずともよいよい♪\n余は王子の、未来の妻だからの♪」: “You needn't say it aloud, dear♪ I'm the Prince's future wife, after all♪”
ep4.「盗み聞きするなんてひどいです！\n王子の馬鹿っ！ 本当にもう……えっと、その、: Eavesdropping is terrible! You idiot Prince! Seriously… uh, you… idiot—!
ep4.「確かちょっと前にやっていたお祭りですよね？」: Sure, it's that festival we had a little while ago, right?
ep4.「確かに前回入賞して王子に褒めてもらってから、\n次も絶対に選ばれるようにって頑: Since I placed last time and you praised me, I've been working hard to be chosen again…
ep4.「祝ってくれる、というのか？」: Is it to celebrate for us?
ep4.「私が人気闘兵で上位入賞ですか……」: Me, placing near the top of the Popular Soldier rankings? …
ep4.「私が入賞……ふふっ、嬉しいなぁ……」: I placed… hehe, I'm so happy…
ep4.「私だって、王子の側にずっといたいですから」: I still want to stay by your side.
ep4.「私の票、投票せずにとっておいたので……」: I saved my vote for you…
ep4.「私はもう、私なんか、なんて言いません」: I won't say “I'm just me” anymore.
ep4.「自らが、我が誓いを守り続けている証明でもあるからな」: It's proof that I continue to keep my oath.
ep4.「自惚れてしまっても、良いでしょうか……？」: May I be a little conceited?
ep4.「街の皆さんが、すれ違うたびに\n『おめでとうクゥイルお姉ちゃん！』って言ってく: “Every time people in town pass by, they shout ‘Congratulations, Quill-big-sister!'”
ep4.「街の皆さんが、シロちゃんおめでとーって言いながら、\nシロにお菓子を渡してくる: Everyone in town is saying “Congrats, Shiro-chan!” and handing me sweets!!
ep4.「見える、見えるよ……スーパー召喚士になったリノが、\n人気闘兵一位になって王子:
I can see it, I can see it… Me, a Super Summoner,
standing at number one, celebrated by you and everyone!
ep4.「貴様のことだ、祭りを名目に復興支援をしているのだろう」: You, you're using the festival as a pretext for reconstruction aid, aren't you?
ep4.「逆に考えればまだ見習い召喚士なのに、\n三回も入賞できてるってことだもん！」:
On the bright side, as an apprentice summoner,
I've managed to place three times already!
ep4.「魔物が復活した当初、諦めることなく\n戦えたのは、王子の存在があってこそ」: When the monsters first reappeared, we could keep fighting because you were there, Prince.
ep4.「魔物が復活した日を、今でも思い出します」: I still remember the day the monsters revived.

m100010.――あくまで抵抗する、か。\n矮小なる被造物の分際で、どこまでも目障りな。: ——So you still resist, huh. A petty creation, you're nothing but a nuisance.
m100010.――おぉ、シャディアよ、海底に来ていたか。\n我は今ここから動けぬゆえ、歓迎もし: —Ah, Shadia, you've come to the seabed. I cannot move from here, so I cannot welcome you…
m100010.――おっと、弱音を吐いている暇はないぞ。\n水に伝わるこの振動……。\nどうやら: —Oops, no time to whine. This vibration through the water… looks like the Giga-Frog's troops are arriving.
m100010.――よし、威力偵察は完了した。\n各自迅速に撤退しろ。\nギガエル様に王子たちの: —Alright, the power scouting is complete. Everyone, withdraw quickly. Report the Prince's info to Lord Giga-Eel.
m100010.――ギガエルを従えたのは、\n亜神の中でも高位の存在なのだということでしょう。: So the one who commands Giga-Eel must be a high-ranking demigod, I suppose.
m100010.――クラールフ、かつての我が主よ、\nあなたも衰えたものだな。\n容易く領土への: ——Klaarf, my former master, you've grown weak too. To let them slip into the territory so easily.
m100010.――クラールフ様！ ご無事ですの！？\n乾いた地の王子様をお連れしましたわ！！: ——Lord Klaarf! You're safe! I've brought the Prince from the dry lands!!
m100010.――シャァァァァァァック！！\nギガエルのクソ天使野郎、イラつくぜェ……。: ――Shaaaack!! That damn Giga-Eel angel, pisses me off…
m100010.――シャァァァァァック！！\nやはり来たか、来てくれたか王子ィ！\nこのオレサマ: Shaaaack!! So you finally came, Prince! You came to fight me!!
m100010.――リバンよ、悔やむ必要はない。\nよくぞ王子達を連れてきてくれた。: —Liban, there's no need for regret. You did well bringing the Prince and his companions here.
m100010.――伝令！ 伝令！\nクラールフ様、海底都市に向けて、\n無数の軍勢が接近中です: ――Messenger! Messenger! Klaarf, countless troops are approaching the underwater city!
m100010.――創造神による、世界の創生。\nこの世界の始まりの時に、\n我らも無数の生命を: —Creation itself, the birth of the world. At the dawn of this world, we sent countless lives out into it.
m100010.――否、それ以上を望んでいることだろう。\n天界の暗躍、突如現れた冥界軍、\nそ: —No, he's after something beyond that. The hidden machinations of the heavens, the suddenly-appearing army of the underworld, and now this incident—everything lines up far too neatly.
m100010.――否、我が意志は今も昔も変わらず。\n海に生きる民を守護することこそ我が本懐。: ——No, my will remains unchanged. Protecting the peoples of the sea is my true purpose. That includes you, Gigael, as well.
m100010.――嗚呼、バハムトの力が流れ込んでくる。\nさすがはクラールフ様に並ぶ海神が\n: —Ah, the power of Bahamut surges within. As befits a divine weapon forged by the sea god who stands beside Klaarf, the magical might of the divine beast Bahamut.
m100010.――来たか、溺れる地の民よ。\n後少しで儀式が終わるところだったのだがな。:
——So you've come, children of the drowning lands.
I was just about to finish the ritual.
m100010.――海神ポセイオス。\nやはり我と敵対するつもりか。: —the Sea God Poseios. So you still intend to oppose me, I see.
m100010.――然り。\nバハムトの力を我が物とする、\nそれこそがこの儀式の目的なれば。:
――Indeed.
To claim Bahamut's power as our own—that's the very purpose of this ritual.
m100010.――然り。\n我らが神の御使い、ギガエル様の手によって、\n深海に適応した溺れる: —Indeed. By the hand of our divine messenger, Giga-Frog, these are the drowning-earth insects adapted to the deep sea.
m100010.――王国の皆様、この海流に乗っていけば、\nすぐにクラールフ様の海底都市に到着で: —Everyone of the kingdom, if we ride this current we'll reach Lady Klaarf's underwater city in no time! ♪
m100010.――王子様、こちらですわ！\nこの先に、バハムトを封印した海溝神殿がありますの！: —Prince, this way! Ahead lies the trench temple where Bahamuto was sealed!
m100010.――王子様、やっぱり海底都市が\nギガエル配下の魚人に\n包囲されているみたいで: ――Prince, it seems the seabed city is being besieged by Giga-Eel's fish-people…
m100010.――生意気な目つきじゃ。\n私の提案を断ったこと、存分に後悔するがよい。: —Such a cheeky look. You'll regret refusing my offer, thoroughly.
m100010.――神獣『バハムト』。\nおそらくは、その復活を目論んでいるのだろう。\n海底に: —The divine beast “Bahamuto.” He's probably plotting its resurrection. It's an ancient god-weapon sealed on the ocean floor.
m100010.――笑止。\n海に生きる者を守ること、それこそが本懐なれば、\n我らが天界に与す: ——Ridiculous. If protecting the sea-dwelling ones is truly my purpose, I could never side with the heavens.
m100010.――貴様にも、身の程というものを教えてやらねば。\n我が配下共よ、進軍せよ！！: ——I must teach you your place. My minions, advance!!
m100010.……あぁ、知っているとも。\nあなたが強情なことも、守るべきものを守るためには、: …Indeed, I know. Your stubbornness, and that you'll even ally with drowning folk to protect what must be protected.
m100010.……あやつめ、確かに千年戦争の頃よりも、\n多少は理性的になったようだな。\nあ: …That one's certainly become a bit more rational than back during the Millennium War. Those shackles must be the relic that soothes his soul.
m100010.……いまさら、だな。\n過酷じゃない戦場なんて、\n王国のこれまでの戦いにあった:
…At this point, huh.
Has any battlefield ever been anything but harsh in this kingdom's history?
m100010.……えっと、友だちだったということですか？: …Um, does that mean we were friends?
m100010.……くっ、ここは深海だぞ。\nなぜ溺れる地の民が、これほどの力を……。\n急ぎ、:
…Damn, this is the deep sea.
How could the drowning-land folk wield such power here?
I must report to Lord Giga-Frog immediately…!
m100010.……その恨みゆえに、\nポセイオスはこの海底都市を狙っていると？: …So, because of that grudge, Poseios is targeting this underwater city?
m100010.……その衛兵たちがいないというのも妙な話だ。\n王子、クラールフ殿の海底都市に\: …It's odd that those guards aren't here. Prince, something might be happening in Klaarf's seabed city.
m100010.……そんなことは、絶対にさせません。\nこっちにはクラールフ様と王子さまがいるん: …I'll never let that happen. We have you, Klaarf, and the Prince on our side! We'll be fine—absolutely.
m100010.……なんだか、あの魚人嬉しそうに見えますわ。\n他のギガエルの配下とは、気配が違: …Somehow those fish-people look pleased. They're… different from the other Giga-Eel minions.
m100010.……ま、まずいですよこれ。\n封印にほころびが生じて、魔力が溢れ出しています。\:
…Well, this is bad.
The seal's cracking and magical energy is spilling out.
The ritual's already underway!
m100010.……まさか、亜神ジーラトス殿か？: …No way, is that… the demigod Ziratoss?
m100010.……やはり魚人では足止めにならなかったか。\nだが、儀式の邪魔となる者の対処は元: …So the fish-people weren't enough to stop you. Still, dealing with anyone who might hinder the ritual is essential.
m100010.……んっ？ あ、あれ？\nあの虫って……異界の虫じゃ……。: …Hm? Ah, that? That insect… it's an other-worldly bug…
m100010.……ギガエル、海溝の底へ沈んでいきます。\n撤退した……のでしょうか……？:
…Gigael, sinking to the bottom of the trench.
Did they… retreat?
m100010.……ジーラトスの枷を解いた、か。\n王子よ、気をつけよ。\nあれはもはや、破壊衝: …So you've freed Giratos' shackles. Prince, be careful. He's become a wild god driven only by destruction.
m100010.……スカーさんの気配が、急速に遠ざかっていきます。\nおそらく海溝神殿へ向かった: …Scar's presence is rapidly fading. He's probably headed for the Rift Temple.
m100010.……儀式と言ったか。\nまさかギガエルよ、\n『バハムト』の眠りを覚ますつもりか: …You speak of a ritual. Surely, Gigael, you intend to awaken Bahamut's slumber?
m100010.……封印を、解く？\nははっ、そうか、そうだな、確かにそう見えるか。:
…Break the seal?
Ha, I suppose it does look that way.
m100010.……改心した、ということか？\nならばなぜ、殺意をむき出しにして、この地へ来たの: …So you've reformed, then? Then why did you come here with murderous intent blazing?
m100010.……残念です、我が主よ。\n愛しき深海の創造主よ。\nこれが、あなたとの決別にな: …A pity, my master. Beloved creator of the deep. So this is our parting, then.
m100010.……気になることを言っていたな。\nクラールフ様に並ぶ、海神だとかなんとか。:
…You said something intriguing.
Something about a Sea God on par with Klaarf…
m100010.……沈没船の残骸を見ると、\nここが海の底なんだって思い知らされるね。: …Seeing the wreckage of sunken ships really drives home that this is the ocean floor.
m100010.……深海で、神獣という言葉を聞くとは。\nクラールフ殿、その封印の地は何処に？: …To hear the word “divine beast” down here… Klaarf, where is that seal located?
m100010.……王子、ギガエルの軍勢が来ます。\n儀式を完遂させるわけにはいきません、\n戦:
…Prince, Giga-Frog's forces are arriving.
We can't let the ritual finish; please take command of the battle!
m100010.……盟友？ ほう、よく見ればその顔、\nガリウスを滅ぼしたという人間の王子か？: …Ally? Huh, look at that face— Is that the human prince who destroyed Garius?
m100010.……確かに。\n手を結んだ以上、これからは\n互いのことをよく知っていきたいもの: …Indeed. Now that we've joined forces, I hope we get to know each other better.
m100010.……神の力を取り戻す手段は、そう多くない。\n現実的な手段を選ぶならば、\n数多: …There aren't many ways to regain divine power. If he chooses a pragmatic route, he'll try to sacrifice countless lives to his cause.
m100010.あっ……いえ、何だか水が\nざわついているような気がして……。: Ah… no, it's just that the water feels… restless somehow.
m100010.あのシャークギルマン、\n攻撃を振るう度に力が増しているみたいですわ！\n王子様: That Shark-Gillman seems to grow stronger with each attack! Prince, please be careful…!
m100010.あの亜神は、いったい何者なのですか？: Who on earth is that demigod, anyway?
m100010.あれはもっと深い場所に棲息しているはず。\n……間違いなく、何者かに率いられた軍: He should be dwelling deeper down… Clearly this army is being led by someone.
m100010.あー、はしゃいでたら、\n確かにちょっとずつ体力が削れていっている気が……。: Ah, when I was goofing around I could feel my stamina slowly draining…
m100010.いえ、お構いなく。\nですが、神獣バハムトの封印の維持、\nクラールフ殿をして、: No, no need. But maintaining the seal on the divine beast Bahamut—does that require such heavy labor from Lord Klaarf?
m100010.いえ、ポセイオスが地上の侵略を狙う以上、\nいつかは私たちとも激突していたはずで: No, since Poseios aims to invade the surface, we were bound to clash with him someday.
m100010.いったい誰が、と問うまでもあるまい。\n我らに敵対するもうひとつの海底神殿、\n: It's obvious who did it. Another underwater temple opposes us, a being who once was a god and now splits the sea with me…
m100010.いや、そうだな……。\n王子よ、貴様が私のものとなるのなら、\n人類に島のひとつ: Actually… Prince, if you become mine, I might even spare a single island for humanity.
m100010.うぅ、だけどこの「水圧」は中々のものよ……。\n海底都市の辺りより、\nさらに身: Ugh, but this “water pressure” is something else… It's even heavier than near the seabed city…
m100010.うぅ、ギガエルを逃してしまいましたわ……。\n周囲の潮流までめちゃくちゃにされて: Ugh, we've let Gigael slip away... The currents around us are all tangled, so we can't even give chase...
m100010.うぅ、何だか暗くなってきてませんか……？: Ugh, isn't it getting kind of dark…?
m100010.うぅ、安全な海路のはずだったのですけれど……。\n乾いた地の王子様、どうか力を貸: Ugh, this was supposed to be a safe sea route… Prince of the dry lands, please lend us your strength!
m100010.うるッせェ海巫女！ 黙りやがれッ！！\n他の魚人が気味悪いぐらい従順になって\n: Shut up, sea-priestess! Be quiet!! The other fish-people are so obedient it's creepy, and it makes me sick!!
m100010.うーん、この状態で戦闘となると、\n結構な苦戦を強いられそうだね。: Hmm, fighting in this condition will force us into a tough battle, huh.
m100010.えぇ、バハムトが解き放たれないように、\nクラールフ様は最も深い海溝に\n封印の: Yes. To keep Bahamuto from being released, Klaarf had a temple built at the deepest trench for the seal.
m100010.えぇ、バハムトの封印は不安定なままだから、\nその影響で突発的な激流や、\n激し: Yes, the seal on Bahamut remains unstable, causing sudden rapids and violent upwellings.
m100010.えぇぇっ、で、でもクラールフさんって\n元魔王軍幹部の超強いタコさんじゃないです: Eeeh— but Klaarf-san is that super-strong former Demon King general octopus! I'm sure it'll be fine, it'll be fine!
m100010.えぇっ、アクシデントだらけでしたよぉ！\n水中呼吸に慣れるの大変でしたし、\n今: Ew, it was full of accidents! Getting used to breathing underwater was tough, and I still feel like I might drown…
m100010.えっ……て、手伝っていただけるのですか……？\n乾いた地の皆様は、大切なお客人だ: Eh… you'll help us? The people of the dry lands are said to be honored guests of Lord Klaarf…
m100010.えっ、そう見えます？ ふっふーん、\n実はクラールフさんとの定期会合に行くと聞い: Really? Huh, actually I heard we were heading to a regular meeting with Klaarf, so I secretly practiced my swimming!
m100010.お、王子の旦那ぁっ！\nあちこちからふわふわした魔物がぁ！？\nそれにビリビリし: Hey, Prince's hubby! Fluffy monsters everywhere! And even fish-people wielding crackling spears!!
m100010.お、王子の旦那ぁ！\n泳ぎはあっちに分があります。\n水中戦闘には十分注意してく: Oh, Prince's husband! I'm better at swimming over there. Be very careful in underwater combat!!
m100010.お、王子様！ 力をお貸しください！\nスカーさんは乱暴者ですけど、\n操られるな: Prince! Give us your strength! Scar's a brute, but being possessed is just too sad!
m100010.おかげで本来はこの深度には現れない、\n深海の魔物も浮上してきたりして\n衛兵た: Thanks to that, deep-sea monsters that normally never surface are rising, and the guards are exhausted…
m100010.おそらくは、偶然ではあるまい。\nかの三亜神の企み、\n世界を揺るがす動乱に繋が: It's probably no coincidence. The scheme of those three lesser gods must be leading to a world-shaking upheaval.
m100010.お前たちが知る必要はない。\nさぁ、まずは小手調べと行こうか。: You don't need to know. Now, let's start with a little test.
m100010.か、海溝だって……？\nもっと深い場所へ向かうのか？: T-the trench...? We're going even deeper?
m100010.くっ……さすがは魚人か。\n水中での逃げ足は随分と速いようだ。: Damn… as expected of fish-folk, their escape speed underwater is impressive.
m100010.くっ……目を覚ますのだ、スカー！\nシャークギルマンは最強だと言っていただろう！: Damn… wake up, Scar! You said the Shark Gillman was the strongest!
m100010.ぐっ……グァァアッ、止まれッ、\n止まりやがれェッ！！\nオレサマのッ、体を返し: Gah… Guaaa! Stop! Stop it!! Give me my body back!!!
m100010.ぐっ……バハムトの力が……っ！\nようやく我が主をお守りする力を、\n手に入れた:
Gah… Bahamut's power…!
Just when I finally obtained the strength to protect my master…!!
m100010.ここが、神獣バハムトを封じた神殿……。: This is the temple that sealed the divine beast Bahamut…
m100010.ここで本来の力を解放するのは愚策だな。\n魚人たちよ、ここは撤退するぞ。\n策を: Unleashing my true power now would be foolish. Fish-people, retreat! We'll rethink our plan and prepare for the ritual.
m100010.この力があれば……我が愛しき主を守護し、\nあの海神を討つことも不可能ではない…: With this power… I can protect my beloved master and even strike down that sea god—it isn't impossible.
m100010.この魔力、ただの精神支配じゃないですね……。\nもしや、神や亜神が用いるという、: This magic… it's more than simple mind control… Could it be the “monsterization” that gods and demigods use…?
m100010.これじゃあギガエルを狙えないですわ……っ！\n王子殿下、どうか慎重な采配をお願い: Then we can't target Gigael…! Prince, please command us carefully!
m100010.これも秘められし作戦の内なのだ。\nよもや神を疑うつもりではあるまい？:
That's all part of the hidden plan.
You wouldn't dare doubt the gods, would you?
m100010.さぁ、儀式もあと少しで完了する。\n溺れる者たちよ、しばしここで待つがいい。:
Now, the ritual is almost complete.
Drowning ones, you may wait here a moment longer.
m100010.さぁ、宴の始まりじゃ。\n者ども、王子を捕らえよ！: Come, let the feast begin. All of you, seize the Prince!
m100010.さぁ、気持ちよく喧嘩させてもらうゼ、王子ィ！！\nテメェのハートはどうだ、テメェ: Come on, let's have a good fight, Prince! How's your heart, how's your rage? Follow me and feel my power!!
m100010.さぁジーラトスよ、枷を解いてやろう。\n人など、荒ぶる亜神にすら\n決して届かぬ: Come, Giratos, I'll release your shackles. Teach humanity that even a raging demigod can never reach them.
m100010.さぁ王子ィ、この先に進みな……。\n傷が癒えたらまた喧嘩挑みに行くからよォ、\n: Now, Prince, move forward. Once you've healed, I'll be waiting for another bout—first go beat that Giga-Eel scum!
m100010.さて、これより儀式完遂のため瞑想に入る。\nお前たちは王子の軍勢を足止めするのだ:
Now, I'll begin my meditation to complete the ritual.
You all hold back the Prince's forces.
m100010.さて、それを教えるつもりはない。\nだがあなたが、天界に兵を差し向けず、\n我ら: I won't tell you that. But if you refuse to send troops from the heavens, and instead join us, turning your blade against the Prince—
m100010.さてさて、そろそろ海底都市が見えてくる頃――\nって、あら……？\n何かがこちら: Now then, the underwater city should be coming into view soon— huh? Oh dear… something seems to be heading toward us…?
m100010.しかし、それにしてもあのクラールフが、\nまさか溺れる民の手を借りるとは……。\: Still, that Klaarf… You actually enlisted the drowning folk's aid? Have you finally lost even your pride?
m100010.そう、神に仇なす程の人間となれば、\nその偉業を愛で、可愛がってやるのが筋という: Indeed, if a mortal dares defy a god, the proper thing is to admire that feat and cherish it. Under my care, you'll receive eternal favor.
m100010.そうですね。\n海底都市と王国は同盟関係にあります。\nこの状況を見過ごすことは: Indeed. The sea-bottom city and the kingdom are allies, so we can't just turn a blind eye to this.
m100010.そして乾いた地の王子よ、\n救援要請をするより早く駆けつけてくれるとは。\nおか: And you, Prince of the dry lands, arriving faster than any request for aid. Thanks to you, my deep-sea folk are safe. I must thank you properly.
m100010.そして我とポセイオスは、共に水を司る神として、\nこの大海に水の民を作り出したの: And Poseios and I, as co-gods of the waters, forged the peoples of the sea within this great ocean.
m100010.その声……海巫女見習い殿か！\nそれに溺れる民の――いや、乾いた地の王子も！: That voice… an apprentice sea-priestess! And the drowning folk's—no, the dry-land Prince as well!
m100010.その正体が神獣――千年戦争で\n使われた、天界の兵器だったなんてね。\n海洋ロマ: And that “something” turned out to be a divine beast—an otherworldly weapon used in the Millennium War. All my oceanic romance just got shattered.
m100010.それが、復活しているということは……。\n解き放った者が敵にいるということですね: So the fact that he's revived means… someone released him, and that someone is an enemy.
m100010.それがしはようやく正義の――\n深海の民を守る……戦士に……なれ――\nグゥッ…: At last I can become the righteous— protector of the deep-sea folk… a warrior… become— Guh… Nuu… Nuo…!?
m100010.それでは王子、負傷者の手当が終わり次第、\n神獣バハムトの調査に向かいましょう。: Then, Prince, once we've tended to the wounded, we'll head out to investigate the divine beast Bahamuto. In the meantime, please take some rest yourself, okay?
m100010.それに、バハムトの封印も\n裂け目が開いたままになっています。\nこのままでは、:
And the seal on Bahamut is still cracked open.
If we leave it like this, the seal might finally break for real someday.
m100010.それにしても、ギガエルはいったい\n何を狙っていたのでしょうか……。: Still, what on earth was Gigael after...?
m100010.それゆえ、こうして各地をめぐり、\n魔力の乱れを整えているのだからな。: That's why I travel the lands, smoothing out disturbances in magical flow.
m100010.それゆえに、我はあやつを叩き潰し、\n二度と復活せぬよう深海に封じたのだ。: That's why I crushed him and sealed him in the deep sea so he could never rise again.
m100010.そんな……急いで海底都市に戻らないと！\n他の魚人たちにも急いで救援要請を、\n: No… We have to hurry back to the seabed city! Send a rescue request to the other fish-people, and… um, what should I do…!?
m100010.た、戦っているのは……。\n衛兵のオーベッドさんと、スカーさん！？: They're… fighting? Guard Obed and… Scar?!
m100010.だからこそ、此度の儀式を遂行するため、\n私自ら、海底都市の戦力を削ぎに来たのだ: That is why, to carry out this ritual, I have come personally to thin the forces of the underwater city—so nothing can stand in our way.
m100010.だが、そうだな……。\n貴様らならば、もしかしたら、海神に手が届くやも……。:
But, hmm…
Perhaps you might actually reach the Sea God…
m100010.だが、その目的を語る必要もあるまい。\nスカーよ、今しばらく此奴らを足止めしてお:
In any case, there's no need to explain my goal.
Scar, keep these fools stalled for a while longer.
m100010.だが、また王子と殴り合えるのはいいゼェ……。\n久々に背びれにビンビンきてやがる: But getting to throw punches with the Prince again is great… It's been a while since my dorsal fin's been this thrilled… Only he can blow my boredom away!
m100010.だがなァ、オスとオスの喧嘩の前じゃ、\n世界の命運なんざどうでもいいよなァ！！: But before two males throw down, the fate of the world doesn't mean a thing, does it?
m100010.だがソフィー、それは些か、誤解というものだ。\n真の目的はバハムトの封印解除など:
But Sophie, that's a bit of a misunderstanding.
My true aim isn't to lift Bahamut's seal.
m100010.だが今は、黒幕のことよりも\n包囲された海底都市を解放する方が先決だろう。: But right now, freeing the besieged sea-bottom city is more urgent than chasing the mastermind.
m100010.だが王国との共闘を経て、\nこの都市の衛兵の士気は高まっている。\n王子殿のおか: But after cooperating with the kingdom, the city's guards have their morale boosted. It's thanks to you, Prince—warriors of the dry lands can't be beaten.
m100010.だが見てろよ……。\nオレサマはもっと強くなるからよォ……。: Just you watch—I'll get even stronger.
m100010.だが！ それがしに傷を付けたことは褒めてやろう！\n次なる戦いでは、\nおぬしら: Still, I'll commend you for daring to wound me! In the next battle, I'll tear off your gills and fins!
m100010.だが！ それがしはあの御方に命を救われ、\n荒ぶる魂を鎮める神器を与えていただい: But! That very one was saved by you, and granted the sacred relic that calms a raging soul!
m100010.で、あれば良かったのだがな。\nあやつは己の領域を広げるために、\n他の生命を滅: It would have been fine if that were so, but he didn't hesitate to destroy other lives to expand his domain.
m100010.ですが、勝利無くして地上の平和はありません。\n必ずポセイオスを打ち倒し、彼の企: But without victory, there can be no peace on the surface. We must defeat Poseios and shatter his scheme!
m100010.ですが、立ち止まるわけにはいきません。\n深海の平和を守るためにも、\n海底都市:
But we can't afford to stand still.
To protect the deep-sea peace, we must join hands with the underwater cities and keep moving forward!
m100010.でもピッキー様、最初に比べて\nとても泳ぎが上手になったと思いますわ♪: But, Lady Picky, I think you've become a much better swimmer compared to when we started! ♪
m100010.とはいえ、地上と比べて\n動きが鈍くなるのは仕方ないか……。\nこの『水圧』のせ: That said, it's inevitable that movement is slower compared to the surface… This water pressure also drains stamina.
m100010.どうした、その反抗的な目は。\nもしやまだ自我が残っているのか？:
What's with that rebellious look?
Do you still have any sense of self left?
m100010.どこまでも自分勝手ですわね……。\nでも、おかげで海底都市に入れそうですわ！: You're selfish to the end… but thanks to that, we might actually get into the city!
m100010.な、なんですか今の音！？\nいったいどこから……！？: Wh-what was that sound?! Where did it come from—?!
m100010.なっ……どういうことですかギガエル様！\nあの御方はバハムトの封印解除を命じてい:
Wh—what does that mean, Gigael!?
Didn't that person order the seal on Bahamut to be broken!?
m100010.なれば貴様にも、身の程というものを教えてやらねば。\n我が配下共よ、進軍せよ！！: Then I must teach you your place. My minions, advance!!
m100010.なんじゃ、その反抗的な目つきは。\n……神の寵愛を断るとは、今の時代の人間は\n: What's with that defiant stare? …To reject a god's favor—people these days are truly insufferable…
m100010.は、はい。この海路は海底都市の、\n腕利きの衛兵隊が定期的に巡回していますから。: Yes, that's right. This route is regularly patrolled by the skilled guard unit of the seabed city.
m100010.ははっ、こちらも同意見だ。\nしかしまずは、\nギガエルの凶行を止める方が先決だ: Haha, I feel the same. But first, stopping the Giga-Frog's rampage is priority.
m100010.ははっ、まったくそのとおりだ。\n――ん、どうしたアクアマリー。\n何か見えたの: Ha, exactly right. —Hm, what's up, Aquamarie? Did you see something?
m100010.ふふふ、これからは深海と地上は\n手とヒレを取り合って歩んでいくのだと聞いていま: Hehe, I've heard that from now on the deep sea and the surface will be vying for each other's hands and fins. Get used to the water while you can.
m100010.ふむ、武装した魚人の部隊か。\nどうやら話し合いをしたいわけではないらしい。\n: Hmm, an armed fish-folk squad. It doesn't look like they want to talk. Prince, we should prepare to intercept.
m100010.へへっ……最高の喧嘩だったァ……。\nまたしてもオレサマの完敗だぜェ……。: Heh… that was the best fight… yet another crushing defeat for me….
m100010.ますます、欲しくなったぞ王子よ。\n物質界全てを海とするこの覇道、\n貴様を手に: My desire grows, Prince. This dominion that turns the entire material world into sea—I wouldn't mind claiming you after I've secured it.
m100010.もしこの後時間があるのなら、\n衛兵たちに訓示のひとつでも頼めないか？\nきっと: If we have time later, could you give the guards a short address? I'm sure they'd be delighted—
m100010.もしそれが目的であるならば、\n人類にとっては避けられぬ戦いとなることだろう。: If that's his goal, then humanity faces an unavoidable battle.
m100010.ゆえに、我は神としての力の全てを注ぎ、\nあやつから神の力を剥奪したのだ……。: Thus I poured all of my divine power into it, stripping him of his godly might…
m100010.よく言うよ、枕元に海洋冒険小説置いてるくせに♪\nでも伝説とのご対面は御免だし、: You talk a lot, especially when you've got a sea-adventure novel on your pillow ♪ But I'd rather skip meeting the legend and just keep the seal intact.
m100010.わ、分かりましたわ！\n王子様、精一杯お助けしますわね！: Yes, I understand! Prince, I'll do everything I can to help!
m100010.ギガエル……かつてクラールフ様が\n神の力を有していた頃、\n補佐として創造した: Giga-Eel… back when Lord Klaarf possessed divine power, he created angels as his aides.
m100010.ギガエル、バハムトの封印を解き、\nいったい何をするつもりなのですか。: Giga-Frog, you've broken Bahamut's seal— what exactly are you planning to do?
m100010.ギガエルの周囲に魔力の渦潮が……。\n王子殿下、矢どころか\n魔法まで渦潮に吸い: A vortex of magical energy swirls around Gigael… Prince, not only arrows but even magic will be sucked into the whirlpool!
m100010.ギガエルの目論見に、解けかけたバハムトの封印。\n調査すべきことばかりが増えてい:
Gigael's scheme, the partially-broken Bahamut seal…
Our list of things to investigate just keeps growing.
m100010.ギガエルは海の命を司る天使です。\nそれゆえに、あの者が魚人たちに\n祝福を与え: Gigael is the angel who governs the sea's life. So it's only natural that he's bestowing his blessings upon the fish-people.
m100010.クソッ……身体が動かねェ……！\nおい王子ィ！ オレサマをっ、殺せェ……！！\n: Damn… I can't move…! Hey, Prince! Kill me…!! I don't want you seeing me like this, miserable!
m100010.クラゲに、高位の魚人まで現れるとはな。\n船上ならともかく、海中で遭遇するのはマ: Even jellyfish and high-rank fish-people appear… On a ship it might be manageable, but meeting them underwater is trouble.
m100010.クラゲもあの槍も、\n触れた者を痺れさせる力を持っているんだ。\n王子、相手をす: Both the jellyfish and that spear have a numbing effect on anyone they touch. Prince, be careful when you face them!
m100010.クラールフよ、これは興が乗ってきたなぁ！\nお前とのつまらぬ戦いに、\nまさか人: Klaarf, this is getting exciting! To think a petty human would meddle in our dull battle!
m100010.クラールフ殿のもとへ急ごう。\nおそらく都市の内部にも、\n既にギガエルの手勢が: Let's hurry to Lord Klaarf. The Giga-Eel forces have probably already slipped inside the city.
m100010.グワッハッッハッッハ！\n枷を解いたジーラトスを打ち破るかッ！: Gwahahaha! Shall we crush the unshackled Giratos?!
m100010.グワッハッハッハ！\nクラールフよ、まさか人間に絆されるとはなぁ！: Gwahahaha! Klaarf, who would have thought you'd be bound to a human!
m100010.グワッハッハッハ！\nクラールフよ、随分な歓迎じゃなぁ！: Gwahahaha! Klaarf, what a warm welcome!
m100010.グワッハッハッハ！\n臣下の言葉は冗談だと思っていたぞ！\nこの深海に、例の王子: Gwahahaha! I thought my subordinates were joking! So the infamous prince has come to these depths!
m100010.ケッ……クラールフのクソ野郎の衛兵が……。\nそんな大口叩いてんじゃねェよ……。: Heh… those damn Klarf guards… Don't go bragging like that…
m100010.シャァァァァァァック！！\n今日もオレサマのイカリは絶好調だゼェ！！\nどこまで: Shaaaack!! My fury's on fire today! Show me how long you can hold out!
m100010.シャァァァァァック！！\nチクショウッ、すまねェ王子ィ！！\nオレサマのイカリが: Shaaaack!! Damn it, sorry, Prince!! My fury won't stop!!
m100010.ジーラトスの心を支配した時と同じように、\n王子、貴様にも首輪をつけてやろうぞ。: Just as I claimed Zirathos's heart, Prince, I'll put a collar on you too.
m100010.スカー……必ずその支配、我らが解いてやろう。: Scar… we'll definitely break that control, together.
m100010.セーシンシハイとか、カイブツカとか知るかァ！！\n王子ッ、オレサマが自分を抑えて: Who cares about “Seishinshihai” or “Kaibutsuka”!! Prince, while I'm holding myself back, hurry up!
m100010.テメェ！！ オレサマに\n慈悲でもかけてるつもりかァ！？: You!! You think you can show me mercy?!
m100010.ヌゥン、そのとおりだとも。\nかつての荒神ジーラトスは、\n敵味方問わぬ悪行を戒: Nuuun, that's right. The wild god Giratos of old was rebuked for his crimes, no matter friend or foe, and you struck him down.
m100010.ヌゥン、それがしは魚人にあらずゥ。\n溺れる地の民よ、我が名を知らぬと申すかァ！: ???: Nuun, I am no fish-person. Drowned-land folk, do you not know my name?!
m100010.ヌゥン！？ や、やめろ……ッ！\nその枷を解かれたら、それがしは、それがしの魂は: Nuuun!? Stop…! If those shackles are removed, my soul—
m100010.ヌゥン？ それがしを知る者がいるではないかァ！\nしかしその知識は些か古いと言わ: Nuuun? So there are those who know me! Yet I must say that knowledge is a bit outdated!
m100010.ヌフゥゥゥウゥン！！\nこれが人間の戦い方か！ 実に小さいィ！！: Nufuuuuun!! Is this how humans fight? How pitifully small!
m100010.ヌフゥン！ 知れたことォ！\nそれがしは正義の亜神ジーラトス！\n正義をなすため: Nufuun! You think you know! I am the just demigod Giratos! To enact justice, I've come to slay the drowning land's prince!
m100010.ピッキーの言うところの超強い元幹部が、\n敵が領海内を泳ぐことを許すと思うか？\: Do you really think that so-called super-strong former executive would let the enemy swim in our waters? …Seems this isn't the time for a meeting.
m100010.ポセイオスよ、人はもはや庇護される者でも、\n寵愛を受ける愛玩物でもない。\n強: Poseios, humanity is no longer something to be protected or a beloved pet to be adored. We stand firmly on the earth, willing to defy even the gods.
m100010.リバン、確かこの海路は\n安全なはずだったと言っていたな？: Liban, didn't you say this sea route was supposed to be safe?
m100010.リバンよ、しばし王子達と行動を共にせよ。\n乾いた地の者には慣れぬ海の旅、\n迷: Liban, stay with the Prince and his party for a while. Those from the dry lands aren't used to sea travel; they'll need our help not to lose their way.
m100010.レヴィアタンの体内にまで\n乗り込んだ軍は言うことが違うな……。\nよし、ならば:
The troops that even penetrated Leviathan's body don't take orders lightly…
Very well, then we'll press onward.
m100010.ロブスナイトまで出てくるなんて。\nこの海域にはいないはず、ですわよね……？: To think a Robes Knight would appear… He shouldn't be in these waters, right…?
m100010.与太話だって何かきっかけがあるもんだろ？\nまぁ、バハムトの正体は\nせいぜい巨: Even a tall tale has a trigger, you know? Well, I always thought Bahamuto was at most some gigantic fish or something.
m100010.乾いた地の方々からすると、\n海巫女の秘術で水中呼吸ができるというのは\n不思議: For those from the dry lands, being able to breathe underwater thanks to the Sea Priestess's secret art must feel like a strange sensation.
m100010.乾いた地の生物を改造したのか！？\n何という……それは創造主の領分を侵す行為だぞ: They've modified dry-land creatures!? That's… an act that infringes on the Creator's domain!
m100010.乾いた地の者からすれば死の世界だろうが、\n我らからすれば地上こそ水なき世界。\: To those from dry land it's a realm of death, but to us the surface is a world without water. It's all about perspective.
m100010.何、我らは海神たる御方の下僕。\nなれば神の赦しを得たも同然よ。: We are servants of the Sea God, so it's as if we have his blessing.
m100010.何が『クラールフと王子の合流を阻め』だ！！\nハナっからオレサマが王子に勝てねェ: What's this about ‘preventing Klaarf and the Prince from meeting'!! As if I've been saying I can't beat the Prince from the start!!
m100010.千年戦争の折、海神によって物質界に降りた亜神の一柱。\n人類の味方として喚ばれた: During the Millennium War, he was one of the demigods sent down by the Sea God into the material realm. Though called a friend of humanity, he's a tyrant who crushes everything in sight, friend or foe alike.
m100010.厄介な者に目をつけられたな……。\nいや、我が戦いに巻き込んでしまったというべき: I've caught the eye of a troublesome one… Or rather, I've been dragged into his fight.
m100010.客人である以前に、私たちは共に戦う仲間だろう。\n王子なんか、今にも駆け出してし: Before they're guests, we're comrades in battle. Prince, you look like you're about to sprint off. This guy's a total softie.
m100010.対天界に向けた定期会合という名目でしたが、\nやはり武装してきて正解でしたね。\: It was under the pretext of a regular meeting with the Celestial Realm, but arming up was the right call. Prince, let's hurry to the seabed city!
m100010.封印の裂け目、拡大が止まりました！\nそうか、ギガエルの儀式を妨害したから……！:
The crack in the seal has stopped expanding!
So that's because we disrupted Gigael's ritual…!
m100010.封印の裂け目から、魔力だけが流れ出しているわ。\nバハムトを封印に残したまま、\:
From the crack in the seal, only magical energy is pouring out.
It's siphoning Bahamut's power while leaving the seal intact…?
m100010.己に奉仕する種族を作る者もいれば、\n自由意志を持つ、新たな生命を生み出した者も: There were those who created races to serve them, and those who birthed new life with free will.
m100010.急ぎ、リバンに案内させよう。\n天界が『バハムト』の目覚めを目論んでいるのなら、: Let Liban guide us quickly. If the heavens are seeking Bahamuto's awakening, we must investigate at once.
m100010.想定より強くなっている、か。\nなるほど、あの方々が警戒するのも頷ける。: They're stronger than I anticipated. I see why those people are on guard.
m100010.愛だ情だと煩わしい……。\n人間など、海という私の寵愛無くして生きられぬ、\nか: Love and affection are a nuisance… Humans can't live without my beloved sea; they're nothing but fragile pets.
m100010.我が主の、『あの方々』のために、\nここでお前の戦力を削らせてもらおう。: For the sake of my master's “those people,” I'll have you waste your strength here.
m100010.我を友だと思ったことが、一度でもあったのか？\n亜神ポセイオスよ、戯言もそれくら: Have you ever once considered me a friend? God-like Poseios, enough with the childish talk.
m100010.旧友が訪ねて来たのだぞ？\n歓迎どころか、銛を向けてくるとは酷いではないか！: An old friend has come to visit, you know? It's cruel to point spears at us instead of offering hospitality!
m100010.案ずるな、クラールフの雑兵になど興味はない。\n私は反抗的な者が好物でのぅ……。: Worry not, I have no interest in Klaarf's lackeys. I relish rebels… I'll make you, Prince, my own.
m100010.案内ありがとうございます、リバンさん。\nおかげでここまで、\n大きなアクシデン: Thank you for the guidance, Liban. Thanks to you we made it here without any major accidents.
m100010.次なる戦いを楽しみにしていよう。\nハハッ、ハハハッ！ グワーッハッハッハッハ！: I look forward to the next fight. Ha— ha— hahahaha! Gwahahaha!
m100010.次に勝つのはオレサマだぜ、王子ィ！\nシャークギルマンはッ！ 最ッ強ッ、なんだよ: Next time I win, Prince! Shark-Gillman is the strongest!
m100010.此れなる者は、我が盟友だ。\n侮辱しないでもらおう、ポセイオスよ。: This one is my ally. Do not insult me, Poseios.
m100010.水が……？ ほ、ほんとですっ。\n水霊たちも騒がしくて――これは……。\n誰かが: The water…? Y-yes, it's true. Even the water spirits are agitated—this… someone's fighting nearby!
m100010.海にロマンを求めるとは、海賊らしいな。\n海軍を預かる者としては、\n眼下に神獣: Seeking romance in the sea, huh? Typical pirate. As someone who watches over the navy, I can't even imagine a god-beast sleeping right beneath us.
m100010.海の命を司る天使たる者が、\n深海の王と、その民に敵意を向けるなんてね。\n存在: An angel who governs the sea's life turning hostility toward the Deep Sea King and his people… To issue orders that outrank its very purpose—
m100010.海の残り半分を手に入れ、その後には\n乾いた地の全てを、海に沈めんとしていたのだ: He seized half of the sea, and then planned to sink all the dry lands into the ocean.
m100010.海を統べる者同士、世界を沈めた後には\nその半分くらいは分けてやろうと思ったもの: As fellow rulers of the sea, after we drown the world, I thought I'd split about half of it with you!
m100010.海底都市よりも深い場所だからな。\n地上の光はここにはわずかにしか届いていないの: It's deeper than the seabed city. Surface light barely reaches here.
m100010.海底都市周辺の海流が乱れていたのも、\nもしやバハムトの魔力の影響なのでしょうか: The currents around the underwater city have been turbulent—could that be the influence of Bahamut's magic?
m100010.海神……？\nクラールフ様以外の、海の亜神が……？: Sea God…? A lesser sea deity besides Klarf…?
m100010.深海の民よ、王子よ……。\n貴様らが何をしたのか、今に思い知ることになるぞ。:
Children of the deep, Prince…
You'll soon learn what you've done.
m100010.溺れる民の王子よ、かつての我が主の\n被造物により、深海にて散るが良い。\n海の: Drowning peoples' prince, by the creations of my former master, may you fall in the deep. By my name, ruler of the sea's life, I begin the purification here.
m100010.然り。愛しき我が子よ。\nお前の信じる、正しき道を行くが良い。\n――だが、その: Indeed. My dear child. Follow the righteous path you believe in. ——but know that the arrows that block it have already been loosed.
m100010.然り。我にかつて程の力は残っておらぬ。\n海巫女たちと我の力を束ねたとて、\nバ: Indeed. I no longer possess the strength I once had. Even when I combine my power with the sea priestesses, maintaining the Bahamut seal is still a real strain.
m100010.王国ってのは強ぇヤツらばかりか……。\n背びれにビンビンきやがるゼェ……。: The kingdom's full of strong guys… their dorsal fins are buzzing with power.
m100010.王子、あの虫が深海の水圧に適応したっていうなら、\n地上の虫より強靭になってるは: Prince, if those bugs have adapted to the deep-sea pressure, they must be tougher than any land insects. Don't let your guard down!
m100010.王子、どうやら会話は望めないようです。\n急ぎ迎撃の準備をお願いします！: Prince, it seems conversation is impossible. Please ready the intercept at once!
m100010.王子、バハムトの封印が破られれば、\n深海にも、地上にも甚大な被害が予想されます:
Prince, if Bahamut's seal is broken, both the deep sea and the surface will suffer catastrophic damage.
We must protect that seal at all costs!
m100010.王子、敵は亜神すらその支配下に置く存在です。\nきっと、この先の戦いは激しいもの: Prince, his enemies even subjugate demigods. The battles ahead will be fierce.
m100010.王子、私たちも海溝の底へ急ぎましょう。\nバハムトの封印を守らなくてはなりません: Prince, we should hurry down to the trench's bottom as well. We must protect Bahamut's seal.
m100010.王子、迎撃に出ましょう！\nポセイオスの企みを砕くために！: Prince, let's go intercept! To crush Poseios's scheme!
m100010.王子さま、敵の魚人が出現しました！\nここは街に近すぎます……いったいどうしたら: Prince, enemy fish-people have appeared! This is too close to town… What should we do…?
m100010.王子さまぁぁぁぁ！！\n大変です！ 巨大な魚人が！！: Prince—!!! It's terrible! A gigantic fish-person!!
m100010.王子よ、私は他の亜神とは違う。\n貴様を殺そうなどとは考えておらぬ。: Prince, I am not like the other demigods. I have no intention of killing you.
m100010.王子様……！！\n……ぐすっ、分かりましたわ。\n最短距離で海底都市までご案内い: Prince…!! …sniff, I understand. I'll guide you to the seabed city by the shortest route!!
m100010.王子様、敵の魚人が急に活発になりましたわ！？\nこれはまるで、\nギガエルの加護: Prince, the enemy fish-people have suddenly become active! It's as if they're under Gigael's blessing...
m100010.王子殿、スカーは攻撃を重ねる度に\nその力を増していく戦士だ！\n攻撃を受け続け: Prince, Scar grows stronger with each attack! Be careful not to keep taking hits!
m100010.王子殿、海溝神殿――\nバハムトの封印領域はもうすぐそこだ。\nおそらく、過酷な:
Your Highness, the trench temple—
the sealed domain of Bahamut is just ahead.
It'll likely be a grueling battle.
m100010.王子殿下！ バハムトの封印が――\nあ、あれ？ 封印は破壊されているのに……？:
Your Highness! Bahamut's seal—
ah, what? It's been destroyed, yet…?
m100010.確かに、海底を歩かず泳いでくる連中を、\n正面から受け止めるのは難しいだろう。\: Indeed, taking on those who come swimming straight at you without walking on the seabed will be difficult. Prince, try to deal with them from range.
m100010.神であった頃のあなたなら、民の犠牲など考えず、\n自ら侵略者にその鉾を突き立てた: When you were a god you'd have cared nothing for the people's sacrifice, and driven your spear straight into the invaders yourself. Yet now you'd become the people's shield and let yourself be wounded.
m100010.神の座を追われた亜神、ですか……。\n力を奪われたとなれば、それを取り戻すために: A lesser god cast out from the throne of divinity… If his power was taken, he'd seek to reclaim it…?
m100010.神獣バハムトか……。\nまさか本当に実在するとはな。\n船乗りたちの与太話だとば: The divine beast Bahamuto... I never imagined it actually existed. I always thought it was just sailors' tall tales.
m100010.私の想像以上じゃよ、王子。\nガリウスの討伐には三女神の力を借りたと聞いたが、\: You've exceeded my expectations, Prince. I heard you enlisted the three goddesses to defeat Garius, yet even without them you seem more than capable.
m100010.私はお前を友だと思っていたのじゃぞ？\n裏切り、私から神の力を剥奪したあの時まで: I thought you were a friend, you know? Until you betrayed me and stripped me of divine power!
m100010.聞くところによりゃァ、\nテメェは大層な使命を負ってるらしいじゃねェか。: I hear you've got yourself a mighty mission, huh?
m100010.荒ぶる亜神、大地を沈める者、万物を砕く無法者、\nジーラトス、お前は我が倒したは: The raging demigod, the one who sinks the earth, the lawless who shatters all things— Giratos, I thought I had already defeated you.
m100010.落ち着いてください、リバンさん。\n増援ならここにいるのですから。: Calm down, Liban-san. Reinforcements are right here.
m100010.詳しくは神殿で話すとしよう。\n王子よ、此度の敵は一筋縄ではいかぬぞ。: We'll discuss the details in the temple. Prince, this foe won't be easy to deal with.
m100010.詳しくは調査してみるしかないですね……。\n海にまつわる伝説は数多くあります。\:
We'll have to investigate in detail…
There are countless legends about the sea.
We'll have to sift through them to find the truth…
m100010.貴様らにそれを知る権利があると思うのか。\nギガエル様の手を煩わせるまでもない、:
Do you think you have the right to know that?
There's no need to bother Lord Giga-Frog; I'll make you fish food right here.
m100010.随分と動きが早い……。\n先手を打ってきたのは、あやつの方だったか。: He moves rather quickly… It seems the initiative came from him, after all.
m100010.頼む、こいつを止めてくれ！\nギガエルによって操られているのだ！！: Please, stop this thing! It's being controlled by a Giga-Frog!!
m100010.（……オレサマは、弱かったんだな。\n痛いほど、それがよくわかったゼ……）:
(…So I was weak, huh.
I can feel it painfully clear now…)
m100010.（それまで、勝負はあずけたぜ、王子よォ……）: (Until then, I'll leave the outcome to you, Prince…)
m100010.（チクショウ……もっと、もっと強く……。\nギガエルのクソ野郎も、海神とやらも、:
(Damn… I need to be stronger…
I want to be able to punch through Gigael's scum, the Sea God, the Prince, the gods—everything…)

m100101.――いえ、確か今日は記念日だと仰っていましたね。: —No, you did say today is an anniversary, didn't you?
m100101.――かつて、千年戦争と呼ばれる戦いがあった。: —Once, there was a war known as the Millennium War.
m100101.――やっほー。遊びにきたよー。: Heyyy! I came to hang out.
m100101.――万慧を砕く者、トゥアン。\n女王自らの振るう戦斧が、\n魔王の軍勢を蹴散らし:
——The one who shatters ten thousand wisdoms, Tuan.
The queen's own war axe scatters the Demon King's forces, turning them into blood-filled smoke.
m100101.――全兵装解放、自動照準、一斉射撃！: —All weapons unlocked, auto-aim, fire at will!
m100101.――命ある人形、アージェ。\n万機の祖と称えられし人形は、\n神の手による兵装を:
——Living doll, Arge.
The doll hailed as the ancestor of all mechanisms unleashes divine armaments and cuts down the Demon King.
m100101.――大地を紡ぐ者、サナラ。\n大地の鼓動を詠む術が、数多の龍脈を束ねていく。: —The earth-weaver, Sanara. Her art that sings the pulse of the land gathers countless ley lines.
m100101.――影の弓手、ネアラ。\n今の世にも名高き影を継ぐ者、\nユージェンが母たるエル: —The shadow archer, Neara. Heir to the famed shadows of this age, Yujen, the elf hunter, lets loose an unerring arrow.
m100101.――数多の妖怪束ねし、山ン本五郎左衛門。\n人を化かし、人を嘲笑うアヤカシの王が: —The master of countless yokai, Sanmoto Gorozaemon. The king of spirits who deceives and mocks humanity, now, for this moment, stands beside men and brandishes his blade.
m100101.――星を詠む者、ソラス。\n星々の囁きを謳う術が、今は空を割き、流星を呼び寄せる: —The star-singer, Solais. His art that chants the whispers of the heavens now rends the sky, summoning meteors.
m100101.――真新しい王城。\n執務室を訪ねると、\n疲れ切った様子の彼が、ソファに転がっ: (narration): —A brand-new royal castle. In the office, the exhausted prince is sprawled on the sofa.
m100101.――神々の加護を受け、共に戦った英傑たち。: (narration): —Heroes who fought under the gods' protection.
m100101.――紫竜を駆る者、アトナテス。\n神と人の間に生まれ、人であることを選んだ騎士が: —The rider of the violet dragon, Atnates. A knight born between god and man, who chose humanity, now roars alongside his draconic half.
m100101.――興が乗った、というところか？ 魔王ガリウス。: “—So you're saying you're excited, Demon King Garius?”
m100101.――英雄たる男ですら、\nそんな悲壮なる覚悟を決めかけた時だった。:
——Even a man hailed as a hero
was on the brink of that tragic resolve.
m100101.――英雄たる者は、問う。\n魔王を倒す者が現れるのは、いつの時代かと。: —Heroes ask, when will a savior who can defeat the Demon King appear?
m100101.――銀腕を掲げし者、トラム。\n神でありながら、人の為に地へ降りた者が、\n魔王:
——One who raises silver arms, Tram.
A god who descended to earth for humanity, now closing in on Demon King Garius's claws and fangs.
m100101.……はい、信じています。\n彼には、運命に抗うだけの意志と、力がありますから。: ...Yes, I believe it. He has the will and the power to defy destiny.
m100101.……まだ、大丈夫。\nまだ耐えられる、人の意志は折れていない。: …We're still okay. The human will hasn't broken yet; we can still endure.
m100101.……兵を二手に分ける。: …We'll split the troops into two groups.
m100101.……分かりました。ですが、指示には従ってもらいます。: …Understood. However, you must follow our orders.
m100101.……最近は、ずっとこうだ。: ...Lately, it's been like this all the time.
m100101.──はーい、天頂運輸からお届け物でーす！\n王国軍最精鋭一個部隊、確かに届けたか: ──Alright, a delivery from Zenith Transport! The kingdom's elite unit, delivered safely!
m100101.──伝令！ 敵部隊が魔界の門に到達しました！: ──Messenger! The enemy forces have reached the Demon Realm Gate!
m100101.──来たか、どうやら間に合ったようだな。: —So you've come. Looks like you made it in time.
m100101.──汝、人の子よ。全てを投げ出すにはまだ早い。: ──You, child of man. It's still too early to abandon everything.
m100101.ああ、アスバール殿なら体調を崩して休んでいるよ。\n彼女とベルゼビュートはコイン: Ah, Asbar is resting his health—he's taken a sick leave. He and Beelzebuth are two sides of the same coin; his revival is probably influencing things.
m100101.ああ、君か……。\nすまない、かっこ悪いところを見せたね。: Ah, you… Sorry you had to see me looking so… unseemly.
m100101.ああ、物質界は任せたよ。: Yeah, the Material Realm is in your hands.
m100101.ああ、見てみたいな……。: Ah, I'd love to see that...
m100101.ああ、遅れてすまない。ドロテア殿、戦況は？: Ah, sorry I'm late. Dorothea, what's the situation?
m100101.あなたこそが、\n英雄たる者の道行きを支え、\n世界の明日を繋ぐ者であると。:
You are the one who supports the path of heroes,
who will bind tomorrow for the world.
m100101.あなたの器は満たされた、覚醒の時です。: ???: Your vessel is filled; the time of awakening has come.
m100101.あなたの物語はここまでよ。死して記憶になるがいい！: Your story ends here. Let it die and become memory!
m100101.あなたも、そうだよね。\n彼がいるなら勝てるって、信じてるんだから。: You feel the same, right? You believe we can win as long as he's with us.
m100101.あらあら、学園の授業はよろしいのですか？: Oh dear, have you finished your academy lessons?
m100101.いずれ仲間が去っていくことは、\n元々旅人だった彼なら、受け入れていたはずだ。: He, being a wanderer at heart, should have accepted that his comrades would eventually leave.
m100101.うむ、それもまた誇り高きオークの道だな。: Hmm, that's also the proud path of an Orc.
m100101.えぇ、もちろん。\nそれでは何を歌いましょうか……。:
Sure, of course.
Then, what shall we sing...?
m100101.ええ、そう名乗らせてもらっています。: Yes, that's the name I go by.
m100101.おお、オークたちはあの激闘の後でも元気だな……。: Wow, the Orcs are still lively even after that fierce fight...
m100101.おお！ そなたは王国の！: Ah! You are from the kingdom!
m100101.お代は世界の平和でいいよ、\nぼくそういうの理解あるから！: The price is world peace— I understand that!
m100101.お前も分かっているはずだ、\nオークの戦士は死と隣り合わせ。\n父にも順番が回っ:
You know as well as I do, Orc warriors live hand-in-hand with death.
Now my turn has come.
m100101.お願い。みんな、どうか踏みとどまって。\nこれを、最後の戦いにするために。:
Please. Everyone, I beg you, hold your ground.
Let this be the final battle.
m100101.かの戦いは、魔王ガリウスによる物質界侵攻に端を発する。\n数で勝る魔王軍は、人類:
That war began with the Demon King Garius' invasion of the material realm.
Outnumbered, the Demon King's forces easily seized humanity's living space.
m100101.きっかけは、アトナテスが旅立った頃か。\nあるいはもっと前から、その兆候はあった: It may have started when Atnates set out, or perhaps the signs were there even earlier.
m100101.きっと王国は、美しく、豊かな国になる。: Surely the kingdom will become beautiful and prosperous.
m100101.けれど、同じだけ、別れもある。: (narration): But with each arrival comes a farewell.
m100101.ここで打って出なければ、\n人類が抗うだけの力はもう、残されていない。:
If we don't strike now,
there will be no strength left for humanity to resist.
m100101.ここで負けてしまっては……元も子もありません……。: If we lose here… there'll be nothing left…
m100101.ここは私たちで抑える、絶対に追加は行かせない。: We'll hold them here. No reinforcements get through.
m100101.この『陽動作戦』は、魔王軍本隊と、\n魔王率いる精鋭部隊を引き離すことが目的なの: This diversion aims to separate the main Demon Army from the elite forces led by the Demon King.
m100101.この世界全ての力がここに集い、\n魔王ガリウスの魔力を削り取っていく。:
All the power of this world converges here,
stripping Demon King Garius of his magic.
m100101.この光は、あの雪原のときと同じ……？: This light… it's the same as on that snowfield…?
m100101.この国が、これからは家族だ。: This kingdom will be our family from now on.
m100101.この数で戦場全域をカバーするのは不可能ですよ！\nせめて隘路だったら蟻一匹通しは:
With these numbers we can't cover the whole battlefield! 
If only it were a narrow pass, we could at least stop a single ant!
m100101.これはまた明日から国中が賑わいそうですね。: Looks like the whole country will be buzzing starting tomorrow.
m100101.これよりあなたは王の剣であり、民の盾。: From now on, you are the king's sword and the people's shield.
m100101.ご安心を、あちらには帝国の方々が加勢されています。\n報告によればヴィディアさん: Rest assured, the Empire's forces are reinforcing us over there. The reports say Vidia and the others are safe.
m100101.さあ、ここからしんどいぞ。: Come on, it's going to get tough from here.
m100101.さあ、皆があなたの助けを待っています。: Now, everyone is waiting for your aid.
m100101.されど、後に英雄王と呼ばれるひとりの男と、\n彼に続く数多の戦士たちの活躍により:
But later, a man called the Hero King, and the many warriors who followed him,
through their deeds, finally gave humanity the chance to strike back.
m100101.しかし、ガリウスは不敵に笑う。\n肉体が崩壊しはじめてなお、\n彼はどこか悲哀を:
But Garius smiles defiantly.
Even as his body begins to crumble,
a sorrow-tinged grin spreads across his face.
m100101.そう、それは千年後のいま。\n彼の血を受け継ぎし、\n語られざる英雄の物語は、続: Indeed, that era is now, a thousand years later. The blood of his lineage continues, and the untold story of the hero goes on—
m100101.そして、永遠の命を授かった者や、\nもとより、長き寿命を持つ英傑たち。: (narration): And those granted eternal life, or already blessed with long years,
m100101.そしてついに、戦いは最終局面を迎える。: And at last, the battle reaches its final stage.
m100101.そなたらはあれと戦うつもりなのだろう？\nであれば、我らも戦列に加えてもらおうか:
You intend to fight that thing, don't you?
Then let us join your ranks. Of course, non-combatants will be sent to other settlements.
m100101.その神器を以って、証明するのです。: With that divine weapon, you shall prove it.
m100101.その間の被害については計算する気も起きないな。: I don't even feel like calculating the damage in the meantime.
m100101.それが、もうひとつの理由。\n女神アイギスの加護を受け、数多の精鋭を従える男。\:
That is the other reason.
A man blessed by the goddess Aegis, commanding countless elite troops.
His presence supports the backs of the human soldiers.
m100101.それが、理由のひとつ。\n蹂躙され続けた人類に、もう、余力はない。:
That is one reason.
Humanity, trampled for so long, has no reserves left.
m100101.それでも、家族や、家族同然の仲間との、\n次にいつ会えるのかも分からない、\nも: Yet, parting from family—or comrades who are like family—without knowing when, or even if, they'll ever meet again...
m100101.それでもなお、彼らはその手で、\n奇跡を手繰り寄せ、己のものとした。:
Yet they still reach out with their own hands,
snatching miracles and making them theirs.
m100101.それに、あれは魔神ベルゼビュートではありません。\n分身か複製か幻影か……なんで: And that isn't the real Beelzebuth. It's a duplicate, a replica, an illusion… whatever it is, it's a fake.
m100101.それに、王国には君が残ってくれた。\nアンブローズも宮廷魔術師を請け負ってくれた: Besides, you've stayed behind in the kingdom. Ambrose took on the role of court mage, and Solais seems to be plotting something amusing.
m100101.それは言外に、答えを拒否したとも読み取れる。\nだがその真意が別にあると、\n英: It could be read as a refusal to answer, but the Hero sensed there was another meaning hidden beneath.
m100101.そんな状況下でありながら、\n人類が反攻作戦に打って出たのは、\nふたつの理由に: Yet, despite that, humanity launched a counter-offensive for two reasons.
m100101.だから、この報告をするときは、\nいつも申し訳ない気持ちになる。: (narration): So whenever I have to report this, I can't help feeling apologetic.
m100101.だからこそ、皆、未来のために命を賭けられる。\nあの人がいれば、必ず勝利を掴める: That's why everyone can risk their lives for the future. With him, we can be sure to seize victory.
m100101.だからこそ、魔王ガリウスが封印された今、\n王国に長くとどまっている理由はない。: (narration): That's why, now that Demon King Garius is sealed, there's no reason for them to stay in the kingdom long.
m100101.だが、お前にはまだ未来がある。\n逃げて生き延びよ、そして強くなれ。:
But you still have a future.
Escape, survive, and grow strong.
m100101.だが、この身は滅びぬ。\n魔の眷属は生まれ続け、この大地を魔界へと染め上げる。:
Yet I shall not perish.
My demonic spawn will keep being born, staining this earth with the demon realm.
m100101.だが、その思い上がりもここまでだ。\n人類、自由、命、願い、\n斯様な些事にしか: But your arrogance ends here. Humans, freedom, life, wishes— you're nothing but fools interested only in such petty matters.
m100101.だがしかし、ここはオーク族父祖伝来の土地。: But this is the land passed down from our ancestors.
m100101.だっ、だとしても我々だけでは──: Even so, we can't handle this alone—
m100101.でっ、伝令！ ゲートよりベルゼビュートが現れました！: Hey, messenger! Beelzebuth emerged from the gate!
m100101.では、剣と盾の形が変わったのも──: Then the change in the shape of sword and shield…
m100101.なに、王国や帝国の本隊が到着するまでの時間稼ぎだ。\n戦線の死守は必要ない、逐次: It's just buying time until the kingdom and empire's main forces arrive. We don't need to hold the line at all costs; we can fall back step by step and keep our distance.
m100101.ならばその魂、我が身に封じましょう。\n魔王ガリウス、あなたを滅ぼす者が、\nこ:
Then I shall seal that soul within myself.
Demon King Garius, until the day someone who can destroy you is born in this world.
m100101.ならば歌いましょう。\n今日はかの戦いが終結したとされる記念日ですからね。:
Then let's sing.
Today marks the anniversary of that battle's conclusion, after all.
m100101.なるほど、ようやく理解できた。\nならば……もはや、殺し合うより他にはないか。: “I see, I finally understand. Then… there's no choice but to kill each other.”
m100101.なるほど、道理で禍々しい気配をしているわけだ。: I see, no wonder there's such an ominous aura.
m100101.なんだこれは、世界は滅んでしまったのか……？: What is this? Has the world perished…?
m100101.ねぇねぇ、今日も何か聴かせてよー。: Hey hey, sing us something today too.
m100101.はい。ですから、彼らの犠牲を――\n彼らの意志と願いを、無駄にするわけにはいきま: Right. We can't let their sacrifice— their will and wishes— be in vain.
m100101.ふふふ、ヴィディアと組むといつもこうですね。: Heh, this always happens when I team up with Vidya.
m100101.ほう、悪くない言葉だ。\n予が貴様との戦いに、期待しているというのか。: “Hmm, not a bad phrase. You're saying you look forward to fighting me?”
m100101.ぼく、大きくなったら王国軍に入るよ。\nあんな風に、みんなを守れるぐらい強くなる: When I grow up, I'll join the kingdom's army. I'll become strong enough to protect everyone like that. So someday I'll have to leave the village—but…
m100101.まさか、本当に勝てるとはな……！: I never imagined we could actually win…!
m100101.まさかよりによってのタイミングで、\n魔神ベルゼビュートが復活するなんて……。: I can't believe the timing—just when this happens, the demon god Beelzebuth revives...
m100101.まばゆい輝きが魔王城を満たし、\n魔王ガリウスの身体が、\n魂が、女神アイギスの:
A dazzling light fills the Demon King's castle,
as his body, his soul, fade into Dan's being.
m100101.みんな、離れて！\n星よ、今ここに……ッ！ 墜ちなさいッ！！: Everyone, get back! Stars, right here...! Fall!
m100101.みんなっ、あと少し……耐えてください！: Everyone, just a little longer... hold on!
m100101.みんなも、そう思ったんだよね。\nだからこの『陽動作戦』に、全軍が参加した。: Everyone thought that too, which is why the entire army joined this diversion operation.
m100101.もしも抗うことを選ぶのであれば、剣を掲げなさい。: If you choose to resist, raise your sword.
m100101.もとより、そのつもりでここへ来たのだろう？: “You came here already intending that, didn't you?”
m100101.やだ、やだよぅ！ どうしてそんなこと言うの！: No, no! Why would you say that!
m100101.よかったです、けど……随分と雰囲気が変わりましたね。: I'm glad, but… you've really changed.
m100101.よし、これより我々は王国に対し感謝の宴を開く。: Very well, we shall hold a feast of gratitude for the kingdom.
m100101.よし、総員出撃だ。指揮は私が執る。文句は後で聞こう！: Alright, everyone, deploy! I'm taking command. Save your complaints for later!
m100101.よもや偶然とは思えん。\nおそらくはずっと我らの背中を\n刺す機会を窺っていたの: It can't be coincidence. He's probably been waiting for a chance to strike us in the back.
m100101.わかんない！ わかんないよ！: I don't understand! I don't get it!
m100101.アスバール殿、もう大丈夫なのですか？: Lord Asbaal, are you alright now?
m100101.アルティア、君はゲートを抜けた奴らを追え。: Altair, you chase the ones who got through the gate.
m100101.エフトラは、霧の向こうに微かに浮かぶ、\n魔王城をまっすぐに見つめる。: Ephra gazes straight at the Demon King's castle, faintly visible beyond the mist.
m100101.ガリウスの周囲に、膨大な魔力が渦巻く。\n魔術の才がない者にすら、\n視界が焼き: A massive vortex of magical energy swirled around Garius, a wave so intense that even those without magical talent felt their vision scorch.
m100101.ガリウスの言葉に、英雄たる男は問いを投げかける。: The Heroic One threw a question at Garius in response to his words.
m100101.ガリウスは、ここに至って、\n初めて玉座から立ち上がった。: At last, Garius rose from his throne.
m100101.ガリウスは玉座から立ち上がることなく、\n英雄たちを睥睨する。\nそこに、言葉ど: Garius watches the heroes from his throne without rising, offering no hint of the praise his words suggest.
m100101.ベルゼビュートの軍勢は魔界の門を狙って進軍中だ。\n放っておけば、物質界が奴の眷: Beelzebuth's forces are marching toward the demon-realm gate. If we let them, the material world will be overrun by his minions.
m100101.ミレイユさんと、セーラさん、\nリンネさんに続く四人目の英傑──: Mireille, Sera, and Linne, the fourth hero after them—
m100101.ミレイユ様とセーラさんが見せた、新たな力──: The new power shown by Lady Mireille and Sailor—
m100101.不味いね、このままだと物質界が奴の眷属で溢れるぞ。: That's bad. If this keeps up, the Material Realm will be overrun by his minions.
m100101.不思議な世界をさまよう異界行の物語、\n果てなき海へ漕ぎ出す航海の物語、\nそれ:
A tale of wandering otherworldly realms,
a story of a voyage into the endless sea,
or perhaps a love story――
m100101.人が……その手を、届かせた、のか……。: Humans... did you... manage to reach me...?
m100101.人の子らよ、よくぞ戦い抜いてくれました。\n魔王ガリウスが死するこの瞬間にたどり: Children of men, you have fought bravely. Had we not reached this moment of the Demon King Garius's death, even I could not have achieved this sealing.
m100101.人の時代は訪れない。\n魔がはびこり、人はただ俯き、死を待つだけの時代が続く。:
The age of humanity will never come.
Demon will reign, and people will only bow their heads, awaiting death.
m100101.人の身で、見事なものだ。\n諦めに伏した人類をまとめ上げ、\n予の居城にまで迫る: To think a mere mortal could achieve such things— rallying the defeated humanity and pressing all the way to my citadel.
m100101.人間よ、英雄たる者よ、初めてだ、このような感情は。: “Human, Heroic One, this is the first time I've felt such emotions.”
m100101.人類軍が大多数の魔物を引き付ける時間が長いほど、\n魔王城に乗り込んだ、彼らの作: The longer the human army can draw the monsters away, the closer those who have entered the castle come to success.
m100101.人類軍総帥、魔を討つ者、人類の希望、\n筋金入りのお人好し、そして――英雄。: Supreme commander of the human forces, slayer of demons, humanity's hope, a true good soul, and— a hero.
m100101.今日は王国の記念日でお休みなんですよ。: Today is the kingdom's anniversary, so we have a holiday.
m100101.今日もひとり、英傑と讃えられし\n彼の仲間が、放浪の旅へ出た。: (narration): Even today, one of the celebrated heroes has set out on a wandering journey.
m100101.今日を生きる君らであれば、\n英雄の問いの答えがいつの時代であるのか、\n既に知: You, living in this day, already know the answer to the hero's question—what era it will be.
m100101.今此処に！ 希望の明日を繋がん！: Here and now! I will bind the hopeful tomorrow!
m100101.伝説の真実を、ここに紐解こう。: Let us unravel the true legend here.
m100101.伝説の英雄と、魔王の物語はこれにて終幕。: Thus ends the tale of the legendary hero and the Demon King.
m100101.何しろ、世界は一度滅びかけたのだ。\nその再興を目指さんとする彼からすれば、\n: (narration): After all, the world once teetered on the brink of destruction. For someone trying to rebuild it, having only one body must be maddeningly limiting.
m100101.何も、永遠に会えなくなるわけじゃない。: It doesn't mean we'll never see each other again.
m100101.依然として予断は許されませんが、\n少なくとも緒戦は我々の完勝でしょう。: We still can't let our guard down, but at least the opening battle is a clear victory for us.
m100101.全てアルティアさんたちのおかげです。お疲れ様でした。: It's all thanks to you, Altair. Great job.
m100101.全然最悪の気分ですが、私だけ休んでもいられません。: I'm feeling terrible, but I can't just rest while you're fighting.
m100101.力を発揮すれば砕けてしまうがゆえ、\n今の時代には残されていない、伝説上の存在で: Yet it shatters when its power is unleashed, so it's a lost legend in these days.
m100101.力を貸してください、これは世界を守る戦いです。: Lend me your strength; this is a battle to save the world.
m100101.劣勢だな、主力が留守の隙を狙われた。\nとにもかくにも兵士の数がまるで足りん。: We're at a disadvantage; our main forces are away and they've been targeted. In any case, we just don't have enough soldiers.
m100101.動ける者は酒と食い物を用意しろ！\n近くの集落のオークも全員呼び寄せろ！: Everyone who can move, prepare food and drink! Summon every Orc from the nearby settlements!
m100101.千年先、二千年先の未来まで、\nこの国に生きる者たちは皆、大切な子どもたちだ。: A thousand years, two thousand years into the future—everyone living in this land will be our beloved children.
m100101.同じ目的のために、共に戦ってきたんだ。\nその目的がなくなったなら、\nそれぞれ: We fought side-by-side for the same cause. If that cause fades, we each go our separate ways.
m100101.同時に、女神アイギスもまた、\nその存在が薄れ、消え始めていた。: At the same time, the goddess Aigis also began to fade, her presence waning and disappearing.
m100101.吼えろヴァリトス！ 俺の魔力を持っていけ！\nこのままヤツをぶち抜くぞッ！！: Roar, Valitos! Take my magic! I'll drive it straight through!
m100101.大丈夫、分かっているよ。\n彼女が旅立ったんだろう？: It's fine, I understand. She's set out on her journey, right?
m100101.娘が帰りを待っているんだ。\n魔王ガリウス、ここで君の物語は終わらせる！: My daughter is waiting for my return. Demon King Garius, your story ends here!
m100101.帝国軍を勝手に代表して私からもお願いするよ。: I'll speak on behalf of the Imperial forces as well.
m100101.彼が日々、激務に追われていることは知っている。: (narration): I know he's buried under endless duties each day.
m100101.彼らの中でも、永遠の命という神の加護を拒否し、\n穏やかな余生を望んだ者は、少な: (narration): Even among them, many refused the divine gift of eternal life, yearning instead for a peaceful old age.
m100101.彼らは元々、それぞれの目的のために、\n英雄の軍勢に加わった者たちだった。: (narration): originally joined the hero's ranks for their own reasons.
m100101.彼女のことだ、王国に――いや、\nこの世界に何かが起きたら、\n放っておけなくて: If anything happens to her—or to the kingdom, or this world—I won't just stand by. I'll be back.
m100101.彼女は、この戦場の被害状況を把握していた。\n上空での偵察が可能な彼女は、\n『:
She was aware of the battlefield's casualties.
From the sky she could scout, and she saw the squads of the human army being wiped out.
m100101.待て、息子よ。行ってはならん、行っては──: Hold on, son. You mustn't go, you must—
m100101.後に、王国軍初代副司令となる者。\nヴィディアは、遥かな魔王城の威容に視線を向け: Later, she would become the kingdom's first deputy commander. Vidya turns her gaze toward the distant, imposing Demon Castle.
m100101.後に王となる男。\n彼を称して、人々は様々な呼び名を付けた。: The man who would later become king. People gave him many titles.
m100101.後に英傑と讃えられる、\n神々の力を帯びし武具の担い手たち。:
Those who will later be praised as heroes,
bearers of divine-powered weapons.
m100101.後継者を見出し、その後見人を\n彼に任せて息を引き取った者もいたくらいだ。: (narration): Some even found successors, entrusted the mentorship to them, and then passed away.
m100101.怖くない……怖くないぞ。\nお前なんか、ちっとも怖くあるもんか！:
I'm not scared… I'm not scared.
You? You don't scare me at all!
m100101.怯えるな、息子よ。お前も勇敢なるオークの戦士。\nハッタリだろうとも構わん、恐怖:
Don't be afraid, son. You are a brave orc warrior.
Even if it's just a bluff, face the fear.
m100101.恐れに立ち向かう魂にこそ『英雄』は宿るもの。: ???: Heroes are forged in souls that stand against fear.
m100101.息子よ、早く逃げるのだ。父のことは置いて行け。: Son, run away now. Leave me behind.
m100101.我々の目的は援軍到着までの時間稼ぎです。\nくれぐれも、無茶だけはしないようお願:
Our goal is to buy time until reinforcements arrive.
Please, don't do anything reckless.
m100101.我らで魔神ベルゼビュートの野望を砕く！！: We'll crush the demon Belzebuth's ambitions!
m100101.我らの意志を継ぎ、誇り高き戦士に──: Carry on our will, become a proud warrior—
m100101.拡散打撃機構ミァハ、\n魔力弾頭多重展開――撃ちます。:
Deploying spread-strike mechanism Miha,
multiple magical warhead deployment—fire!
m100101.挨拶は後程改めて。\n魔神ベルゼビュートの軍勢が迫っています。\n今すぐに避難し:
We'll talk greetings later.
The army of the demon god Belzebuth is approaching.
Evacuate immediately.
m100101.旅の終わりというのは、\nいつだって、こういうものさ。: The end of a journey always looks like this.
m100101.明日……そうです、ヴィディア様たちは！？: Tomorrow… right, what about Lady Vidia and the others!?
m100101.易々と侵略者に明け渡すことも、\n戦わずして逃げ出すこともできん。: We cannot simply cede it to invaders, nor flee without a fight.
m100101.時は千年の昔。\n人の世が終わらんとしていた、魔王との戦いの時代――。:
Long, long ago, a thousand years past.
When the world of men was about to end, during the age of war with the Demon King――.
m100101.時代が時代なら、見る者にある種の知識さえあれば、\nその魔力が魔に類するものでは: In another age, anyone with a certain knowledge would have realized that this power wasn't demonic at all, but the very magic of a god.
m100101.来いッ！ 王国の剣が貴様らの相手になる！: Come! The kingdom's blade will face you!
m100101.楽しませてやるさ。\nだが、その上で――勝つのは人類だ。: “I'll give you a show. But in the end—victory belongs to humanity.”
m100101.次はどいつだ！\nあたしが戦いってやつを教えてやるッ！！:
Next up, whoever you are!
I'll show you what a real battle looks like!!
m100101.死にませんよ。老兵は死なず、ただ去るのみ──です。: I won't die. An old soldier doesn't die; he just departs— that's all.
m100101.泣き言は後だ、今はやるしかあるまい。: Whining can wait; we have no choice but to act now.
m100101.滅びのみがお前の目的ではあるまい。\n――ならばガリウス、お前は何を願う。: “Destruction isn't your only goal, is it?—Then, Garius, what do you truly desire?”
m100101.滅びゆく者共がそれを知って何とする。: “What would the doomed ones do with that knowledge?”
m100101.物質界に侵略の橋頭堡なんて築かれてみたまえ。\n害虫駆除には十年単位の月日を要す:
Let them try to build a foothold of invasion in the Material Realm. 
Eradicating a pest like that will take decades.
m100101.王国には、新しい人材が次々とやってくる。\n世界中から、彼を慕う者たちが\n少し: (narration): New faces keep arriving at the kingdom, admirers from across the world gathering to lend even a little strength.
m100101.王国軍遠征部隊の長にして！ \n王子殿下の剣、万民の盾なり！: Leader of the kingdom's Expedition Force! The Prince's sword, the people's shield!
m100101.癒し手たるイムラウが、エフトラに並び立つ。\n周囲に治癒魔法を施し続けているが、: The healer Imlau stands beside Ephra, continuously casting healing magic around them, though fatigue shows on her face.
m100101.知識欲の魔神としては大変興味深い現象なんだが──: As a demon of curiosity, it's a fascinating phenomenon—but...
m100101.私たちも近場にいた遠征部隊の寄せ集め、\nこの数でどれだけ進行を抑えられますかね: We're just a ragtag group of nearby expedition troops—how much can we really hold back with these numbers?
m100101.私の力に、あなたの願いが呼応した結果です。: My power, responding to your wish, has made this possible.
m100101.空と大地が、黒に染まっていく……。: The sky and the earth are being dyed black…
m100101.総員、迎撃態勢！ 会敵します！: All units, prepare to intercept! Enemy contact!
m100101.胴上げだ！ 新たなる英傑殿を天高く舞い上げよ！: Lift them up! Raise the new hero high into the sky!
m100101.自信に満ち溢れていた彼の表情に、\n少しだけ、寂しさが浮かぶようになってきた。: The confidence that once filled his face now carries a hint of loneliness.
m100101.英雄たる彼は今、仲間たちとともに、\n魔王ガリウスと対峙していた。: The hero now stands with his companions, facing Demon King Garius.
m100101.英雄たる男の剣が、魔王ガリウスの首を貫く。\n剣を極め、魔を極めた英雄であってさ:
The hero's blade pierces Garius's throat.
Even a hero who has mastered both sword and demon,
without his comrades, that blade would never have found its mark.
m100101.英雄たる男の武具は、\n長き歴史に幾度もその名を語られる。: The Hero's armor, whose name has been spoken throughout the ages, gleamed with a history that spanned countless generations.
m100101.英雄たる男は、その答えに対し、ただ静かに頷いた。: The Hero simply nodded in quiet acknowledgment.
m100101.英雄たる者、自らの魔力を結晶化した、\n戦士の傷を癒やす秘宝。: A hero's treasure, a crystallized form of his own mana that heals a warrior's wounds.
m100101.英雄と呼ばれた者よ、その問い、答えは簡単だ。\n予もまた、貴様と同じ道を征く者な: “He who was called ‘hero,' the answer to your question is simple. I, too, walk the same path as you.”
m100101.英雄は、剣を構える。\n彼の携える聖剣、魔剣は数あれど、\nその手にあるのは神域: The Hero readied his sword. Though he carries many holy and demonic blades, in his hand rests the Chosen King's sword granted from the divine realm.
m100101.落ち着いてください、ゲートから現れた敵は一体。\nそれこそ魔界で仲間がまだ戦って: Calm down. The enemy that emerged from the gate proves our comrades are still battling in the demon world—
m100101.行きましょう、イムラウ。\nこの作戦を、絶対に、何があっても成功させるんです。: Let's go, Imlau. We'll see this plan through, no matter what happens.
m100101.説明は後です、まずは敵を一掃しましょう。: We'll explain later—first, let's wipe out the enemy.
m100101.誰もが、死と隣合わせの状況にあった。\nひとりでも欠ければ、全滅は免れない戦況で:
Everyone stands on the brink of death.
If even one falls short, total annihilation is inevitable.
m100101.議論している時間はない、\n今ならまだ間に合うはずだ。:
No time for debate. 
If we act now, we might still make it.
m100101.足並みを乱すわけにはいかぬからな、了解した。: We can't afford to lose cohesion. Got it.
m100101.運命を前にして膝を突くか、\n回天の試練へと立ち向かうか。:
Will you kneel before fate,
or stand against the trial of the heavens?
m100101.遠征部隊は私に続いてください！ ゲートを抜けます！: Expedition Force, follow me! We're going through the gate!
m100101.遠征部隊総員、これより反転を開始します。: All expedition forces, commence the reversal now.
m100101.適材適所だ、後輩のために死ねるなら本望だろう？: It's the right fit—dying for a junior like you would be an honor.
m100101.選王の剣、女神アイギスの神器に並び、\n数多の伝承に謳われるもの。\nそれこそ、: The Chosen King's sword, alongside the goddess Aegis's relic, sung of in countless legends—it is, in fact, that “Healing Magic Crystal.”
m100101.頼んだぞ、人類の未来を、\nこの世界全ての願いを……！: I'm counting on you— the future of humanity, the wishes of this entire world…!
m100101.馬鹿な、それじゃあヴィディア様たちは──: No way, that means Lady Vidia and the others—
m100101.魔王の言葉が事実であると示すかのように、\n床の血溜まりが、濃い魔力を帯びていく:
As if to prove his words true, the blood-soaked floor swells with dark magic.
From it arise new hordes of monsters.
m100101.魔王は、英雄の言葉に、にやりと口元を歪めた。\nそれは少なくとも、\nこの世界の: The Demon King twisted his mouth into a grin at the Hero's words—a expression no one in this world had ever witnessed.
m100101.魔王は、英雄の言葉に、微かに笑ってみせた。\n彼の配下ですら見たことのない、\n: The Demon King gave a faint smile at the Hero's words, a look that even his minions had never seen—one that seemed genuinely intrigued.
m100101.魔王を化かすのも悪くない。冥土に送ってやらァ！: Deceiving the Demon King isn't so bad. Let's send him to the afterlife!
m100101.魔王ガリウス、人の時代を返してもらう。: Demon King Garius, return this age to humanity.
m100101.魔王軍が無尽蔵に魔物を投入する中、\n人類軍の数は限られている。\n戦場に出られ:
While the Demon King's army poured endless monsters into the fight,
the human forces were limited.
Even those who could reach the battlefield were few.
m100101.（ここで前に出られないようでは、\n私はもう胸を張って王子の隣に立てない）:
(If I can't step forward now,
I'll never be able to stand proudly beside the Prince again)
m100101.（すぐに動くべき案件はいくらでもありますが──）: (There are countless urgent matters we could attend to—but...)
m100101.（それも、戦力にならない負傷兵と子供を救うために）: (All to save the wounded and children who aren't even a combat asset)
m100101.（今日ぐらいは、勝利に浸らせてあげるべきですね……）: (For today, we should let them bask in their victory...)
m100101.（子供！？ なんで、助け、いや、間に合わ──！）: (A child!? Why… I have to help, but it's too late—!)
m100101.（想定よりも圧が強い、ここは戦線を少し下げて──）: (The pressure's stronger than we thought; we need to fall back a little—)
m100101.（愚行、無謀、暴挙、短慮、軽率、失策、悪手──）: (Foolishness, recklessness, rashness, short-sightedness, carelessness, blunder, misplay—)
m100101.（指揮官が敵の包囲のど真ん中に突撃するなど、\n今まで私は書物から何を学んできた:
(Charging straight into the enemy's encirclement—
what have I ever learned from the books...?)
m100101.（援軍の到着までこの命が保つかどうか……）: (Will I survive until the reinforcements arrive…)
m100101.（王子、もしも私が死んでしまったなら。\nそのときは、どうか花と涙を手向けてくだ:
(Prince, if I should die,
please lay flowers and tears before me.)
m100101.（相手はオークです。説得はするだけ無駄かと）: (Our opponent is Orcs. Persuasion seems futile.)
m100101.（魔神……もう出てくるなって、言ったのに……）: (Demon… I told you not to come out again…)
m100101.（魔神ベルゼビュートの突然の復活。\n本体の居場所もまだ掴めていない以上、\n次: (The sudden resurrection of the demon god Belzebuth... We still don't know where its true form is, so we have no idea where or what will happen next...)

m200582.――お久しぶりです、ランスさん、シィルさん。\nそれから、初めましての方々も……:
――It's been a while, Rance, Sill.
And… I suppose this is our first time meeting, everyone else?
m200582.――ふふ。ねえ、そこの偉そうな方のセーレ。: ――Heh. Hey, you, the one acting so superior, Seire.
m200582.――次元の狭間,どこでもない場所: (narration): ――The gap between dimensions, a place that is nowhere
m200582.――王子！ ご無事でよかったです！\n魔力の追跡、こちらでも結果が出ました。:
――Prince! I'm glad you're safe!
We got results from the magic tracking on our end, too.
m200582.――皆さん、魔神セーレの討伐、\n本当にお疲れ様でした。: ――Everyone, thank you so much for defeating Demon God Seire.
m200582.――開け、異界の門。\nいでよ、異世界の英雄ランスよ！！:
――Open, gate to another world.
Come forth, Rance, the hero from another world!!
m200582.――魔神セーレ討伐、出陣前のこと: ――Before marching out to slay the Demon God Seire
m200582.…………。\nまぁよい。\n今は言い争っている場合ではない。:
…………
Very well.
Now is not the time for bickering.
m200582.……あっ、砕けました！\nセーレの不死性、消えましたよー！:
……Ah, it shattered!
Seire's immortality is gone!
m200582.……あっ。ランス様、呪いの魔力が、\n二本とも同じ場所に向かってます。\nたぶん:
……Ah. Master Rance, the cursed mana from both of them
is heading toward the same spot.
That's probably the Mana Furnace chamber!
m200582.……あの、ランス様、王子様。\nちょっと気になることがあるんですけど……。:
……Um, Rance, Prince.
There's something that's been bugging me……
m200582.……あの、王子。\nハニーが、こちらをじっと見てきます。:
……Um, Prince.
The Honeys are staring at us.
m200582.……あの二人、同時に術を組んでるわよ。\n干渉して、とんでもないことになるんじゃ: ……Those two are casting spells simultaneously. They're interfering with each other. This could go terribly wrong……
m200582.……あの男と王子の目。\n今、我らが仲違いすれば、まとめて狩られるぞ。:
……That man and the Prince's eyes.
If we fall out now, we'll be hunted down together.
m200582.……あの魔神、魔法への耐性がとても高そう。: ……That Demon God seems to have very high resistance to magic.
m200582.……そういうこと。\n呪印を通して、内側に魔力を流し込めば。:
……So that's it.
If we channel magic power through the curse mark, into the inside.
m200582.……そうだな。\nまずは、あのふたりに復讐を。:
……You're right.
First, we take revenge on those two.
m200582.……だが、まだ終わらん。\n貴族気取りの偽物より先に、私が貴様を殺す。:
……But it's not over yet.
Before that pretentious fake can get to you, I'll be the one to kill you.
m200582.……ちゃん、はやめてほしいのだけど。: ……I'd prefer if you didn't use the "-chan" suffix.
m200582.……ったく、呪いがかかっててこれかよ。\n頼もしいというか何というか。:
……Damn it, and he's cursed too.
I don't know whether to feel relieved or worried.
m200582.……つまり、俺様は、\nセーレをぶっ飛ばすまで女の子に近づけんのか。:
……So, I, Rance,
can't get near any woman until I blast Seere away?
m200582.……なぜ、まだ生きている。\nこれだけ近くにいるというのに……。: ……Why are you still alive? Even though you're this close……
m200582.……ねえ、シィル。ダーリンの呪印、\nまだセーレと繋がってるのよね？:
……Hey, Sill. Is your curse mark on Darling
still connected to Seire?
m200582.……はいはい、女性陣は下がりましょう。\nセーレを倒せば済む話よ。:
……Alright, alright, ladies, let's step back.
It'll be resolved once we defeat Seere.
m200582.……はいはい。\nさあ、帰りましょう。門が閉じる前に。:
……Yes, yes.
Come on, let's head back. Before the gate closes.
m200582.……はらほろ……ま、まだだ……。\nまじんなんとか、覚悟しろぉぉぉ……。:
……Grrr… not yet….
You demon god, prepare yourself…!
m200582.……ふぅん。あなた、すごい魔力ね。: ……Hm. You have quite the powerful magic.
m200582.……ふぅん。悪くないじゃない。\nそれじゃ、こっちも本気を出そうかしら。:
……Hmm. Not bad at all.
Well then, I suppose I should get serious.
m200582.……ふん。この俺様が、\n男に助けられるとは不本意極まりないが。:
……Hmph. I, Rance,
find it deeply unsatisfying to be helped by a man.
m200582.……もしかして、その術式、発動条件が\n「女性が数メートル以内に入ると」になって: ……Could it be that the activation condition for that spell was "when a woman enters within a few meters"?
m200582.……もしかして似合ってませんか？: ……Do you not think it suits me?
m200582.……やるじゃない。まさか私を退けるなんて。\nなら、こっちも本気よ。:
……Not bad. I didn't expect you to push me back like that.
If that's the case, I'll have to get serious.
m200582.……ん？ いない！？ どこへ消えた！: ……Huh? They're gone! Where did they vanish to?
m200582.……フン、人間なんぞ二秒で肉塊だ。: Satella?: ……Hmph. Humans are nothing but meat after two seconds.
m200582.……嫌な空気だ。\n魔力が、どこかへ吸い上げられている。:
……I don't like this atmosphere.
Mana is being sucked away somewhere.
m200582.……待て。炉の魔力が、暴走している。: ……Wait. The furnace's magic is running wild.
m200582.……本物のハニーが混ざっているようです。\n様子がおかしいのは、あちらの――:
……It seems the real Honeys are mixed in.
The ones acting strange are over there――
m200582.……来るな。まだ呪いが……あ、いや。\n……何も起きんな？:
……Stay back. The curse is still… ah, no.
…Nothing's happening, is it?
m200582.……貴様が炉に入れ、紛い物。: ……You're the one who entered the furnace, the impostor.
m200582.……転移？ いえ、これは召喚術ね。\nそれも、世界を跨ぐ規模の。:
……Teleportation? No, this is a summoning ritual.
One that spans across worlds.
m200582.「――盛大に吹き飛びランスは爆死する！」\nおい偽物の私、詠唱の邪魔をするな！: "—blow up spectacularly, killing Rance in a fiery death!" Hey, fake me, stop interfering with the incantation!
m200582.「ランスよ、貴様は二度と我に近付くこと叶わぬ。\nもし近づけば、貴様のハイパー兵: "Rance, you shall never approach us again. If you do, your hyper-weapons will explode and—"
m200582.あ、あの、リア様……？\n本当にそんなこと言ってましたか？:
U-Um, Lady Ria……?
Did you really say those things?
m200582.あちこちにめちゃくちゃに門が出現していて、\nこのままだと元の世界へ帰る門が開け:
Gates are popping up all over the place in a total mess,
and at this rate, we won't be able to open a gate back to the original world.
m200582.あっ、また逃げました。\nほんとに逃げ足だけは一級品ですねー。:
Ah, he ran away again.
His escape speed is truly first-rate.
m200582.あっ、異界の門で帰っちゃいましたー。\nでも、大事な情報を落としていきましたねー:
Ah, they went back through the Interdimensional Gate.
But they left some important information behind.
m200582.あっ、逃げましたー。\n自分の居城に戻ったみたいですねー。:
Ah, she ran off~.
Looks like she's headed back to her fortress~.
m200582.あの魔神さんには魔法が効きにくいです。\n私の魔法も、グリムさんの魔法も……。:
Magic doesn't work well on that Demon God.
Neither my magic, nor Grimm's……
m200582.あら、あれが噂の王子？\nふぅ～ん……。:
Well, well. Is that the famous Prince? 
Hmm……
m200582.あら、ちょうどいいわ。\n現地弟子のデビュー戦ね。:
How convenient.
Looks like our new local disciple is making her debut.
m200582.あれ、ドッペルゲンガーですねー。\nランスさんに縁のある女性に化けてるみたいです:
Oh, Doppelgangers.
They seem to be disguising themselves as women close to Rance.
m200582.あんたにはいい薬じゃない？\n――おっと、ちょうどお迎えが来たみたい。\nグリム:
Sounds like a good remedy for you, doesn't it? 
—Oh, looks like your ride has arrived. 
Grimm! Over here! Open a gate right here!
m200582.あーん、ずるい！\nダーリン、リアも！ ぎゅーっ！:
Aww, that's not fair!
Darling, Ria wants one too! Gyuuu!
m200582.いいでしょう、受けて立ちます。: Very well. I'll accept your challenge.
m200582.うぅん、似合ってる。\nそれじゃアウローラ、さっそく実践よ。:
Hmm, it suits you.
Now then, Aurora, let's get right into practice.
m200582.うわぁ、異界の門が思いっきり暴走してますねぇ。\nここにも勝手に門が開いちゃって:
Wow, the interdimensional gates are going haywire. 
One just opened up here on its own. 
I don't know if it was targeted or just an accident.
m200582.えぇい！ 私を無視するな！\nちょうどいい、全員まとめてここで息の根を――:
Hmph! Don't ignore me! 
This is perfect. I'll finish you all off right here and—
m200582.ええい、ぐぬぬ……！\nおい、敵はまだか！ 鬱憤をぶつける相手はどこだ！:
Hmph, grumble……! 
Hey, where are the enemies! I need someone to vent my frustration on!
m200582.えへへ……ランス様のことなら、\n私、いつも見てますから。:
Ehehe…… I'm always watching
over Rance, after all.
m200582.おい、王子。\nなんで俺様の周りがむさい男ばかりなんだ。:
Hey, Prince. 
Why is it only ugly men surrounding me?
m200582.おう！ 行くぞ王子！\nそして俺様の呪いを解くのだー！:
You got it! Let's go, Prince!
And I'll be lifting my curse on myself too!
m200582.おぉ、グリムちゃん。\nその前に、この世界の女の子と――:
Oh, Grimm-chan.
Before that, though, I was just about to say something to the girls of this world—
m200582.おおっ、女の子たちが心の友に殺到しておる！: Oh my, the girls are all rushing to their soulmate!
m200582.おのれ、おのれ魔人セーレ！\n俺様のハイパー兵器の恨み、覚えておけー！！:
You wretched Demon Seire! 
Remember the grudge I bear against your hyper-weapon!!
m200582.おもしろいからいるだけー。: I'm just here because it's fun~.
m200582.おもしろそうだからいついちゃったー。: It looked fun, so I came along~.
m200582.おもしろそうだからさんかー。: It looks fun, so I'll join~.
m200582.おー、志津香さんがふたりになりました。: Oh wow, there are two Shizuka-sans now.
m200582.お前こそ邪魔だ！ 術式を譲れ！: *You're* the one interfering! Hand over the spell!
m200582.がははは！ いいぞハニワども！\nもっとやれ！:
Gahaha! Nice work, you Haniwas!
Keep it up!
m200582.がははは！ ようやくだ！\nセーレをぶっ飛ばして呪いを解いて、女の子と――:
Gahaha! Finally!
I'll blast Seire, break the curse, and then with a girl――
m200582.きゃっ……何なの、ここ？\nダーリン、ダーリンはどこー？:
Kyaa…… What is this place?
Darling, where are you, Darling?
m200582.くっ……なぜ私の兵ばかり減っている！: Tch…… Why are only my troops getting wiped out!
m200582.くっ……魔力炉だ、魔力炉で決着を……！: Tch…… The Mana Furnace. I'll settle this with the Mana Furnace……!
m200582.ぐっ……がぁぁぁっ！？\nな、何だ、この魔力は……内側から……！:
Grrr… Gaaah!?
W-what is this magic power… from the inside…!
m200582.ぐぬぬ……この私が、押されるとは……。: Grrr…… To think I'd be pushed back…….
m200582.ぐぬぬ……この私が、魔人ごときに……！: Grrr…… I, of all people, being bested by a mere demon……!
m200582.ぐぬぬぬぬぬぬぬ！\nもうどうなっても知らぬ！\nいざ、呪いの詠唱を！！: Grrrrrrrr! I don't care what happens anymore! Now then, let the incantation begin!!
m200582.ぐぬぬぬぬ！:
Grrr!
--- scene: Aurora, Disciple of the Four Witches (battle, battle) ---
m200582.このにせもの、めがねっこをたたいたよね。: We hit up those fake glasses-wearers, didn't we?
m200582.この部屋の偽ハニーは全て私の眷属！\n本物のハニーも私のしもべだ！:
All the fake Honeys in this room are my subordinates!
Even the real Honeys are my servants!
m200582.さて、異界の門はランダムに開いちゃってるので、\nまずは王国領内の門を調べていき:
Well, since the gates to other worlds are opening at random,
let's start by checking the ones within the kingdom's borders.
m200582.じゃあアウローラ、その魔力、\n治癒にしか使ってないの？ もったいない。:
Then Aurora, you only use that power for healing?
That's a waste.
m200582.せっかくですし、模擬戦で連携を確認しましょう。: Since we have the chance, let's run a sparring match to check our coordination.
m200582.そう、我らに近づけば……ん？: Yes, if you approach us…… Hm?
m200582.そうじゃぞ心の友よ。異世界の魔神じゃ。\n無敵結界も持っとらんし、儂の出番はない: That's right, my friend of the heart. We are a Demon God from another world. I don't even have an invincible barrier, so it's not my time to shine.
m200582.そうだぞ。私が編み上げた必殺の呪いだ！: That's right! It's my ultimate curse!
m200582.それでですねー、悪い知らせがふたつあります。: Well then, I have two pieces of bad news for you.
m200582.それでは、門を開きますよー。\n皆さん、お元気でー。:
Then, I'll open the gate.
Take care, everyone.
m200582.それと、はい、これ。\n着替えてきなさい。:
And, here, take this.
Go change into it.
m200582.それに、異世界に来たのも、\n悪いことばかりじゃなかったし。:
Besides, coming to another world
wasn't all bad.
m200582.それはハニーの好みの話だろう！？: That's just a matter of the Honeys' preferences!
m200582.そんなことはありませんが。: I wouldn't go so far as to say that.
m200582.だあっ！ いい加減、顔合わせる度に\n抱きついてくるのやめんか！: Gah! Can you please stop tackling me every time we meet?
m200582.だが、呪いは完成した！\nくらえ、ランス！: But the curse is complete! Take this, Rance!
m200582.だーって、やっと近づけたんだもーん！: But I finally got the chance to get close!
m200582.ちっ……のがしたか……。\nまぁよい。呪いはかけた。じわじわ苦しむがいい。:
Tch…… Let him go…… 
Well, that's fine. I've already placed the curse. Suffer slowly.
m200582.ちっ……！ 今回はここまでだ。\nだが、魔力炉は既に動いている！:
Tch……! This is where I'll retreat for now.
But the mana furnace is already in motion!
m200582.ちょうどいい。貴様らを殺した方が本物だ。\nそれで決着とする！:
Perfect timing. Whoever kills you is the real one.
Let's settle it that way!
m200582.ちょっと、なんで私まで……！\nはぁ、嫌な予感しかしないわ。:
Hey, why am I here too……!
Sigh, I have a bad feeling about this.
m200582.ですねー。門を開ける魔力まで、\n減衰させられてる感じがしますー。:
Right. It feels like even the mana
needed to open the gate is being dampened.
m200582.でも、あのふたり、\n全然連携する気がないですよね……？:
But those two don't seem
to have any intention of coordinating at all……?
m200582.と、とにかくだ！ 辿れるなら早く辿れ！\n俺様は一刻も早く女の子に――:
A-Anyway! If you can track it, do it quickly!
I want to get to the girls—
m200582.どうせ偽物の貴様が邪魔をしたからだ！\n術式が歪んだのだ！: It's because you, the fake, interfered! The spell got distorted!
m200582.どっちでもいい。両方死ね。: Doesn't matter to me. Die, both of you.
m200582.どわぁぁぁぁっ！？\nまたか！ またこれかー！！:
Whaaat?!
Again! Why is this happening again!!
m200582.な、なんだ、身体が……紛い物と、混ざる……！？: W-what is this… my body… mixing with the false one…!?
m200582.な、なんだ貴様ら！ 私は魔神セーレだぞ！\nハニーの力を宿した、真の――:
W-What is this! I am the Demon God Seire!
The true vessel of the Honey's power――
m200582.なってるわよ。教えるって決めた相手に、\n半端な格好でいてほしくないだけ。ほら、: It does. I just don't want to be teaching someone in a half-hearted outfit. Come on, hurry up.
m200582.なにをぅ！？ 私だぞ！: What did you say?! It was me!
m200582.なら、私の出番ね。\n魔導具は魔法じゃない。物理。:
Then it's my turn.
Magical artifacts aren't magic. They're physical.
m200582.ならば……さらった者どもを人質に――: Then…… I'll use the ones I abducted as hostages——
m200582.なるほど、現在、魔神セーレとランスさんは、\n呪いという魔力の糸で繋がっています:
I see. Right now, Demon God Seire and Rance are
linked by the threads of the curse's magic power.
If we follow that presence……?
m200582.なるほど。つまり――\n偽物なら、遠慮なくぶっ飛ばしていいのだな！:
I see. So that means――
If they're fakes, I can blow them away without hesitation!
m200582.なんか、似た者同士って感じですねー。: They really are cut from the same cloth, huh.
m200582.なんかいっぱいいるー。: There are so many of them~.
m200582.にせものだー。であえであえー。: It's a fake~. Let's go, let's go~.
m200582.ぬ……またしても余計な者が紛れ込んだか。: Hmph…… Unwanted extras have mixed in again.
m200582.ぬおっ！？ 何だ、身体が……いや、\nハイパー兵器が、熱いような……。: Nngh!? What is this? My body…… no, my hyper-weapons are getting hot……
m200582.ぬぐっ……！？ やはり貴様、\n私を魔力炉に投げ込むつもりだったな！:
Nngh……!? So you were planning
to throw me into the Magic Furnace after all!
m200582.ぬぐっ！？ サテラにシィルにかなみ……！\nいや待て、シィルは後ろにいたはずだぞ:
Huh!? Satella, Shirl, and Kanami……!
Wait, Shirl should have been behind me……?
m200582.ぬっ……魔人か。\nふん、偽ハニーどもよ、まずは眼鏡どもを狙え！:
Hm…… A demon.
