A large number of…… Honeys, apparently.
m200582.王子、魔神の対処は我々にとっても急務です。\nランスさんの呪いを解くためにも、\:
Prince, dealing with the Demon God is urgent for us as well.
To lift Rance's curse as well,
would you be willing to cooperate in the subjugation of Demon God Seere?
m200582.王子。……まあ、なんだ。\n男に世話になるのは二度とごめんだが。:
Prince. …Well, I guess.
I'm not about to let a man take care of me again, though.
m200582.王子。この世界で見たもの、忘れないわ。\n……種族を越えて共に戦う、その形を。:
Prince. I won't forget what I saw in this world.
…The shape of us fighting side by side, regardless of race.
m200582.王子様、皆さん、お世話になりました！\n今度こそ、へんでろぱを……あっ、時間が！:
Your Highness, everyone, thank you so much for your hospitality!
This time for sure, I'll definitely… Ah, look at the time!
m200582.王都に、異界の門がふたつ……。\n眷属が溢れ出しているようです！:
Two gates to another world in the capital……
It seems their minions are pouring out!
m200582.異世界の戦士ランス、そして王国の王子。\n三度目の正直だ。今度こそ、貴様らを殺す:
Warrior Rance of another world, and Prince of the Kingdom.
This is the third time. This time, I will kill you for real.
m200582.異世界の戦士ランス、そして王国の王子。\n今度こそ、貴様らに引導を渡してくれる。:
Rance, the warrior from another world, and the Prince of the Kingdom.
This time, I will guide you to your doom.
m200582.異界からさらわれた人たちだよ！\n魔力を吸われてるみたい！:
They were abducted from another world!
It looks like their mana is being drained!
m200582.異界の門、閉じましたー。\nでも、こういう門が王国中にあるんですよねぇ。:
The gate to the other world is closed.
But there are gates like this all over the kingdom.
m200582.相変わらず、賑やかな人たちでしたねー。: As always, quite the lively bunch, weren't they?
m200582.相変わらず品のない男よ。\nさぁ眷属ども！ この者らを魔力炉の餌にせよ！:
As rude as ever.
Now then, my minions! Feed these people to the mana furnace!
m200582.確かに。互いを見る目に殺気があるわ。\n仲間じゃないのかしら。: Indeed. There's a killing intent in the way they look at each other. Are they even on the same side?
m200582.私がそばに寄っただけで、\nさっきも本当に爆発しちゃって……。:
I only came close to him,
and he actually exploded just now…
m200582.私が先に人質に取ったのだ！ ハニホー！: I took them hostage first! Haniho!
m200582.私が厳しいのは相手を見込んでる時だけよ。\n……あ、今のは聞かなかったことにして:
I'm only strict when I see potential in someone.
……Ah, pretend you didn't hear that.
m200582.私が敵役をやるわ。\n教えてあげるから、練習代わりに撃ってみなさい。:
I'll play the enemy.
I'm going to teach you, so shoot at me to practice.
m200582.私が構築した呪いだ！ 貴様は下がっていろ！: It is *my* curse! You stay out of this!
m200582.私こそが真の魔神セーレ！\n異世界の戦士ランス、王子、覚悟せよ！:
I am the true Demon God Seire!
Warrior of another world, Rance, Prince, prepare yourself!
m200582.私こそ本物だと何度言えば！: How many times do I have to say I'm the real one!
m200582.私の予備よ。汚したくないでしょ、その白い服。\nそれに、魔法使いを教わるなら形か:
It's my spare. You don't want to get that white dress dirty, do you?
Besides, if you're going to learn from a mage, you should start with the look.
m200582.私の偽ハニーもだ！\n貴様、手を抜いたな！:
And my fake Honeys too!
You're holding back, aren't you!
m200582.私の全力、見せてあげる。: Let me show you my full power.
m200582.私は治癒士です。\n攻撃魔法を使う必要はありません。:
I am a healer.
I have no need to use attack magic.
m200582.素直じゃないわね。……ま、いいけど。: You're not very obedient, are you? ……Well, fine.
m200582.肩書も長いですし、アウローラと呼んでください。: That title is quite long. Please, just call me Aurora.
m200582.良い連携が組めそうで何よりです。\nそれでは皆さん。決戦の準備を！:
I'm glad you two seem to be getting along well.
Now then, everyone. Let's prepare for the decisive battle!
m200582.見てください、あそこ……人が捕まってます！: Look, over there…… people are trapped!
m200582.見よ。砕かれた魂の欠片から、\nついにこの魔神セーレが蘇ったぞ。:
Behold. From the shards of a shattered soul,
the Demon God Seire has finally been reborn.
m200582.見ろ。この者たちの魔力を炉に注ぎ、\n紛い物を吸収し、私は真の魔神として蘇るのだ:
Behold. I will pour these people's mana into the furnace,
absorb the imposter, and resurrect as a true Demon God.
m200582.見分けなど知るか！ 全部ぶっ飛ばす！: Who cares about telling them apart! I'll blow them all away!
m200582.視線が鬱陶しいな……。眼鏡が原因なのか？:
Their gaze is really irritating……
Is it because of my glasses?
m200582.言ってないわよ？\nでも、思ってはいるでしょ。あの顔。:
I didn't say a thing.
But they're thinking it, aren't they? Look at their faces.
m200582.貴族の方は転移術が厄介。\n丸い方は魔法が効かない。……面倒な組み合わせね。:
The Noble one's teleportation is a pain.
The round one is immune to magic. ……A troublesome combination.
m200582.貴様、俺様に迷惑ばかりかけおって。: You've only ever been a nuisance to me.
m200582.貴様、魔人……ホーネット派の魔人か……！: You…… a demon…… One of the Hornet faction, are you……!
m200582.貴様が入れ！ 偽物め！: You're the one who should be in there! You fake!
m200582.貴殿の安全のためだ。\n我々が壁になるゆえ、女性は近寄れん。:
It is for your safety. 
We shall serve as a wall, so no woman can approach.
m200582.転移でぶっ飛ばされても、戻れば戦えますー。\n魔法が効かない方は、物理でどうぞー:
Even if we get teleported away, we can fight once we're back.
As for the one immune to magic, just use physical attacks.
m200582.逃げ足の速い魔神ですね……。: What a quick escape for a Demon God……
m200582.開け、異界の門！ ハニホー！: Open, gate to another world! Haniho!
m200582.隠していたのではなく、\n使う機会がなかっただけです。:
I wasn't hiding it.
I simply never had the opportunity to use it.
m200582.難しいことは分からんが、要するに\nあの二匹はまとめてぶっ飛ばせばいいんだな！:
I don't get the complicated stuff, but basically,
we just need to blow both of those bastards away, right?
m200582.面倒ね。魔法使い泣かせだわ。: What a pain. She's a mage's nightmare.
m200582.鬱憤晴らしだー！！\n野郎ども、ついてこい！:
Time to blow off some steam!!
You guys, follow me!
m200582.魂を砕かれてなお立ち上がった\nこの私こそ、真の魔神セーレ！ ハニホー！:
I, who rose again despite my soul being shattered,
am the true Demon God Seire! Haniho!
m200582.魔人なんとかが二匹に増えとる。: The demon thing has multiplied into two.
m200582.魔力の使い方に慣れすぎなのよ。\n今まで隠してたわね？:
You're just too used to how you've been using your mana.
You've been hiding it, haven't you?
m200582.魔力の流れは、あちらだ。\n……丸い方――えぇと、ハニーの方と言うべきか。:
The flow of mana is heading that way.
……The round one——I mean, the Honey one.
m200582.魔力炉で決着をつけようではないか。\nランス、王子、貴様らもだ！ ハニホー！:
Let's settle it in the Magic Furnace, then.
Rance, Prince, you're included too! Hani-ho!
m200582.魔神たちの反応は……この王都の中です！: The Demon Gods' reaction is…… inside this capital!
m200582.黙れ紛い物！\nランスを殺すのは私だ！:
Shut up, fake!
I'm the one who'll kill Rance!
m200582.黙れ！ まぁよい！\n今回は前回までの教訓を活かし、\n確実に貴様を殺す術を用意: Silence! Very well! This time, I have learned from my past defeats and prepared a surefire method to kill you.
m200582.（ここまでの密度、修行というより刑罰に近いな……）: (At this density, it's less like training and more like a punishment……)

m320209.あらためて、本当にありがとうございました。: Once again, thank you so much.
m320209.おう、喧嘩祭りだ！\nせっかくこんな強い王子と知り合ったんだ、\n拳と拳で語り合:
Hey, a brawl festival! 
Since I finally got to meet such a strong prince,
don't you want to settle things fist-to-fist?
m320209.そういえば、\nお祭りを開きたいとのことでしたが……？:
Come to think of it,
you said you wanted to hold a festival...?
m320209.ともかく皆さんのおかげで、\n魔王軍の企みを挫くことができました。\n私の方から:
Anyway, thanks to everyone,
we were able to thwart the Demon King's army's plot.
Let me thank you myself.
m320209.よぉーし、そうと決まれば早速準備だ！\nエリザベス、手伝ってくれよな！:
Alright then, it's settled—let's get started! 
Elizabeth, help me out!
m320209.メリオダスさん、\n本当に店主さんだったんですね……。:
Meliodas-san,
so you really were the shop owner...?
m320209.私はエリザベス。\nリオネス王国第３王女で、\n今は〈豚の帽子〉亭のウェイトレス:
I'm Elizabeth.
Third princess of the Kingdom of Leoness, and now I also work as a waitress at the “Pig Hat” tavern.

m400150.――え、えっと、帝国天馬騎士の\nクラーラです！ し、失礼いたしましゅ！！: ――Uh, um, I'm Clara, an Imperial Pegasus Knight! I—I'm sorry!!
m400150.……あ、ありました！ えっとですね、\n大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\: …Ah, here it is! The Grand Annihilation Mission's primary objective is simply “to defeat the enemies.”
m400150.……えっと、王国へと接近している\n飛行型魔物の群れの対策に、\n帝国の飛空船を: …Um, regarding the request to use an Imperial airship to deal with the flock of flying monsters approaching the kingdom…
m400150.……こちらについて、\n帝国から正式に許可がおりましたので、\nその事をお伝えに: …We've received official permission from the Empire, so I've come to tell you that.
m400150.……との事です！ 良かったぁ、\n噛まずに言え…………ってあぁっ、\nもう一枚メ: …That's what they said! Phew, I managed to say it without biting… Ah! I have another note!
m400150.『全く、やすやすと貸せる代物ではないのだがな。だが\n王国に倒れられても困る、今: “Honestly, it's not something we can just lend out easily. But we can't have the kingdom fall, so we'll make an exception this time,” that's what Lady Leona said.
m400150.えっと、王子様、よく聞いてくださいね。\n今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的とし: Prince, please listen carefully. This battle is a “Grand Annihilation Mission” whose sole purpose is to defeat the enemies.
m400150.す、すみません、噛んでしまいました。\nあぅ～……やはり、王子様の前では\n緊張: S-sorry, I bit you… Ah—…As expected, I get nervous in front of the Prince…
m400150.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないので\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、: Therefore, deployment cost won't recover over time, so be sure to include anyone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or cavalry in your sortie.
m400150.ですので、自軍の被害を抑えるより\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: So, rather than minimizing our own casualties, the focus is on killing as many foes as possible.
m400150.また、ライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ: Also, the mission clears even if your life reaches zero, and the number of enemies you've slain is counted as your achievement.
m400150.わ、わかりました、ではそのように\nお伝えしてまいります。それでは失礼し……って: I—I understand. I'll pass that along. Well then, excuse me… uh, I'm sorry, I forgot to tell you something important!
m400150.今回は飛空船上での戦いとなりますので、\n部隊が上手く展開できません。: Since this fight takes place aboard an airship, your troops won't be able to deploy properly.
m400150.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear getting hurt—concentrate on taking down as many monsters as you can.
m400150.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありまして。\n……: Grand Annihilation Missions differ from regular missions in a few ways. …Let me see… I think I have a note here…
m400150.敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできませんので\n: Even if you defeat enemies, you won't earn EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400150.既に飛空船の配備は進めており、\nいつでも出撃は可能との事ですが。\n……え、準: The airships are already being deployed and are ready to launch at any time. …So, if they're ready, does that mean we can go right away?
m400150.王子様、どうかくれぐれも\n気を付けてくださいね……それでは、\n『大討伐ミッシ: Prince, please be extra careful… Now then, please issue the “Great Extermination Mission”!
m400150.矢を通さない硬質化したガーゴイルや、\n先に伝えた一つ目の魔物の青い個体等\n新: There are also hardened gargoyles that arrows can't pierce, plus that blue one-eyed monster we mentioned earlier—new species seem to be showing up.
m400150.魔物の中には、普段はあまり見かけない\n一つ目の魔物の群れも確認されています。\: Among the monsters, we've even spotted a herd of one-eyed creatures you don't usually see. Be careful not to be thrown off by their erratic movements.
m400150.魔物達を指揮しているのは、雷を操る\n巨躯の魔物とのこと……報告は以上となります: The monsters are being led by a massive, lightning-wielding beast… that's all for my report. …Phew, I finally managed to say everything without biting!!

m400192.――王子、此度は貴国の協力によって\n我ら白の帝国と貴国とで行う合同軍事演習が\: —Prince, thanks to your kingdom's cooperation, we're able to carry out this joint military exercise between the White Empire and your nation without a hitch.
m400192.……さて。今回の演習においては\n普段の魔物討伐の任とは異なる\n『大討伐ミッシ: …Now then, for this exercise we'll use a format different from our usual monster-hunting missions—a “Grand Hunt Mission.”
m400192.そこで、今回はより一層の連携強化を図るべく、\n以前の演習に参加できなかった兵た: So this time, to further tighten our cooperation, we'd like even those soldiers who missed the previous exercises to gain combat experience alongside your troops.
m400192.それでは『大討伐ミッション』開始とさせて頂く！: Then, let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
m400192.たとえライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nそれまでに倒した数はカウントされ\n: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain will be tallied as your achievement.
m400192.つまり、自軍の被害を恐れるよりも\n少しでも多くの相手を打ち倒す事に\n専念する: In other words, focus on eliminating as many foes as possible rather than worrying about your own casualties.
m400192.まず大討伐ミッションでは\n『敵を撃破すること』\nそれのみが唯一の目的となる。: First, the sole objective is simple: defeat the enemy.
m400192.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできない。\n: Defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops—remember that.
m400192.兎に角一人でも多く相手を倒す、\nそれこそが最も重要だ。: The more opponents you take down, the better—that's what matters most.
m400192.其方も気を抜かずに相手をしてくれ。\n此度の演習も王国と帝国双方にとって\n意義: So don't let your guard down either. I hope this drill proves valuable for both the kingdom and the empire.
m400192.出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も留意しておけ。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ: Also note that deployment cost doesn't recover over time. Make sure to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your deployment team.
m400192.大討伐ミッションでは通常のミッションとは違い\n幾つか異なる点がある事に注意して: Keep in mind that a Grand Hunt Mission differs from regular missions in several ways.
m400192.有事の際の連携を速やか且つ強固なものとするには、\n互いの戦力の把握が不可欠だか: To make emergency coordination swift and solid, we must understand each other's capabilities. Use this chance to showcase your strength as well.
m400192.演習とは言え、こちらは手を抜くつもりは毛頭ない。\n実戦と同等の緊張感をもって臨: Though it's an exercise, we won't hold back at all. We must approach it with the same tension as real combat, or it won't be meaningful.
m400192.演習は帝国領内の軍事施設で実施することとなる。\n貴国の兵たちにも予めそう伝えて: The exercise will take place at a military facility within imperial territory. Please inform your troops of this in advance.
m400192.過去に行われた合同演習では、\n我ら帝国軍と貴軍との連携強化を目標の一つに掲げ、: In past joint drills we set strengthening coordination between our imperial forces and yours as a goal, and I think we achieved that to some degree.

m400372.――とうとう、決別の時か。\n我が物顔でオリュンポスに出入りしながら、\n敵であ:
――At last, the time of parting has come.
I've been coming and going from Olympus as I please, yet you—an amusing fellow—publicly declare yourself my enemy.
m400372.――どれ、少しだけその力を味わってみるとしよう。\n王子よ、あの日からどれだけ、:
――Now, let's taste a fragment of that power.
Prince, show me how much you've honed your strength since that day.
m400372.――無謀なる破滅に突き進みながらも、\nそれを理解できぬ、夢しか見られぬ人類のあ: ――while humanity rushes toward reckless ruin, unable to understand it, dreaming only.
m400372.――王子、失礼します！\n負傷兵の治療、完了しました！\n戦える者はすべて、整列: —Prince, excuse me! The wounded have been treated! All combat-ready troops are now in formation!
m400372.……あの怒らせたら手がつけられないロタンが、\n大人しく遅滞戦闘なんてしてるかし: …I wonder if that enraged Rotan, who's impossible to handle when angry, would actually sit still for a prolonged fight.
m400372.……いや、余を見限ったとでも言いたいのだろうな。: …No, you're saying you've given up on me, aren't you?
m400372.……その結論こそ間違いであると、\n突きつけてやらねばなるまいな。: …I must confront that conclusion, for it is wrong.
m400372.……戦闘状態、というわけではないのね？: …So it's not exactly a combat state?
m400372.……王子、あなたは良い兵に恵まれているのですね。\nあの猫耳の少女、皆の緊張を一: …Prince, you're blessed with fine soldiers. That cat-eared girl eased everyone's tension in an instant.
m400372.……魔王城周辺に、お宝なんてないわよ？\n天界の勢力も金銭に興味なさそうだし……: …There's no treasure around the Demon King's Castle. The Celestial forces don't seem interested in money anyway.
m400372.「ライフが０になってもクリア」となるため、\n敵戦力を削ることを最優先とし、\n: Since the stage clears even if your life hits zero, reducing enemy forces is top priority—let's carve a path forward.
m400372.あなたと、王国軍の力を信じています。\nどうか、魔界と、私のロタンをよろしくお願: I trust you and the Kingdom's forces. Please, see to the Demon Realm… and my Rotan.
m400372.ぐぬぬ、やっぱり\nEXPもゴールドもドロップ品もなしかぁ！: Grrr… So no EXP, no gold, no drops either!
m400372.そのため、可能な限り\n『多くの敵を倒すこと』を目的としたミッションとなります。: Therefore, this mission focuses on defeating as many enemies as possible.
m400372.そのどちらが、より世界を長く存続させるのか、\nどちらが世界にとって価値ある未来: Which of those paths will let the world endure longer? Which yields a future worth having? It seems that man has finally reached a conclusion.
m400372.それだけの戦力が相手ならば、\n大部隊による「広域戦闘」となりそうですね……。: With that kind of opposition, it'll turn into a large-scale, wide-area battle...
m400372.ただ、ここは魔界の中でも、\n物質界との補給路から離れた地点です。\nよって、出: But this is a spot deep in the Demon Realm, far from any supply lines to the material world. So deployment costs won't recover over time.
m400372.ところでぇ、前回の魔王城じゃ、\nお宝をこっそりいただけなかったわけだがぁ……。: By the way, back at the last Demon King's Castle we couldn't snag any treasure… Think we can just take all the gold and loot this time?
m400372.ん、そうね……。\n小規模な戦闘は起きていたけど、\n基本的には包囲を狭めつつあ: Right… Small skirmishes have broken out, but overall the siege is gradually loosening.
m400372.ルキファよ、魔王城へ向かうぞ。\n憎き三女神の力、少々形は異なるが、\nこの手に:
Lukifer, we head for the Demon King's Castle.
The hated Three-Goddess power may differ in form, but I'll take it back into my hands.
m400372.代わり、というわけでもありませんが、\n三女神の力の残滓は健在の様子。\n魔界の: Not that it replaces anything, but the remnants of the Three Goddesses' power are still strong. We should be able to avoid the demonic miasma.
m400372.変化も衰退も進歩もない、\n安寧と停滞の時代を望む余のあり方と――: No change, no decline, no progress—my desire for an age of peace and stagnation—
m400372.心配、ですね……。\nあの子が無事なら、\nきっと大乱戦になっているはずですから: That's worrisome… If that kid makes it out okay, the battle will surely erupt into chaos.
m400372.忍びの皆さん、偵察ご苦労さまです。\n魔王城周辺はどうなっていましたか？: Everyone, thanks for the reconnaissance. How's the area around the Demon King's Castle?

They're not just cute, mischievous, hungry rabbits.

It's being pushed to the point of spraying poison indiscriminately…
No, it would be more accurate to say the poison is leaking out.
m500472.地形を利用して押し留めていますが、それも限界です。\n兵士たちの疲労も激しく、間:
We're using the terrain to hold them back, but it's reaching its limit.

The soldiers are exhausted, and a new assault is likely to begin soon.
m500472.宴会であれば……我がパヤモ領が誇る伝統の……\nタケノコフェスティバルをご覧に入:
If it's a banquet… let me show you the traditional pride of my Payamo territory…
The Bamboo Shoot Festival…
m500472.射手と癒し手の配置、連携には細心の注意が必要ですね。: We need to be extremely careful with the placement and coordination of our archers and healers.
m500472.我らと兵の命を全て使い潰したところで、\n一週間も保たないだろうと推測されます…:
Even if we expend every last soldier and every drop of our strength,

I estimate we won't last a week…
m500472.手遅れになる前に前線の連中を退かせろ。\nここから先は、我々で彼奴らを受け持つぞ:
Pull the front line back before it's too late.

From here on, we'll deal with them ourselves.
m500472.毒への対策がないとすぐに動けなくなっちゃいます！: Without a countermeasure for the poison, we'll be immobilized in no time!
m500472.汚染された魔界の土壌も早速浄化が進んでいる。\nそう時間をかけずとも元の状態に戻:
Purification is already underway for the contaminated soil of the Demon Realm.
It should return to its original state without taking much time.
m500472.深い霧と、濁り切った空気……この先に、魔神が。: Thick fog, and air so heavy it's suffocating… The Demon Gods lie ahead.
m500472.王子、力を貸してください。これは魔界を守る戦いです。: Prince, lend us your strength. This is a battle to protect the Demon Realm.
m500472.王子、至急魔界へ援軍を送りましょう。: Prince, we must send reinforcements to the Demon Realm immediately.
m500472.王子様、アスタロトは迂闊に倒したら駄目です！\nあれ、でもここで絶対に倒さなきゃ:
Prince, we can't just carelessly defeat Astaloth!
But we absolutely have to take it down here, and—
m500472.現在、魔神とその眷属が魔界を進行中だ。\n棲み家を追われた魔物たちの暴走も相まっ:
The Demon Gods and their subordinates are currently advancing through the Demon Realm.

Combined with the rampaging of the demons who have been driven from their homes,

the entire region has descended into chaos overnight.
m500472.瘴霧が、バルバトスに集まって──！？: The miasma is gathering around Barbatos—!?
m500472.私はアスタロトの毒の方が怖いかなー。\n麻痺とかさせられちゃったら最悪かも。:
I'm more afraid of Astaloth's poison, though.
If it paralyzes us, that would be the worst.
m500472.突如あの二体が手を組んだ原因の究明は進んでいない。\n偶然か、我々の調査能力不足:
We haven't been able to determine why those two suddenly joined forces.
Was it a coincidence, a lack of investigative capability on our part, or perhaps—
m500472.美しい戦いではなかったが、勝利は勝利だ。\n見ろ、あの無口な領主が珍しく騒いでお:
It wasn't a beautiful battle, but victory is victory.
Look, that taciturn lord is making a rare scene.
m500472.考えるまでもなく、最悪のシナリオですね……。: It goes without saying, but that would be the worst-case scenario…
m500472.聞いたことある……これ、狩人の瘴霧だ。\n魔神バルバトスが本気の本気になった証、:
I've heard of this before… This is the Hunter's Miasma.
It's proof that the Demon God Barbatos is getting serious for real.
A declaration that he will never let his prey escape.
m500472.自分でも体内の毒素が制御できていないみたい。\n今のアスタロトはほとんど爆弾みた:
It looks like it can't even control the toxins inside its own body.
Right now, Astaloth is basically a walking bomb.
m500472.証拠を残さない何者かの仕業、ですか。: The doing of someone who leaves no evidence.
m500472.逃げる、避ける、防ぐ。どれにせよ命を大事に、だな！: Run, dodge, or defend. Whatever you do, keep your life safe, all right!
m500472.部隊の編制、輸送の時間を考えると、\nもはや一刻の猶予すらもありません。:
Considering the time needed for unit formation and transport,

we don't even have a moment to spare.
m500472.際限なく溜め込んだ魔力が内部で臨界に達した場合、\n溢れた毒素と瘴気が物質界にま:
If the magic power they have hoarded without limit reaches a critical point,

the overflowing toxins and miasma could leak into the Material World.
m500472.魔神バルバトスと魔神アスタロトが手を組んだ。\nこう言えば、嫌でも現在の状況が分:
The Demon Gods Barbatos and Astaloth have joined forces.

That should make the gravity of the situation clear enough.
m500472.魔神バルバトスの操る瘴霧による、\n呼吸不全と視界不良、厄介ですね……。:
The miasma controlled by the Demon God Barbatos is causing

respiratory failure and obstructed vision. It's a nuisance…
m500472.（魔神……もう出てこないと……いいなぁ……）: (I hope the Demon Gods don't show up again…)
m500472.～～～～ッ！ とにかく安全重視で頑張ってください！: ~~~~! Anyway, please do your best while prioritizing safety!

m900456.――それでは、\nエキーオーン討伐の作戦会議を始めましょうか。: ――Then, let's begin the strategy meeting for the Equeon subjugation.
m900456.――ッ！？\n王子、エキーオーンから強大な魔力の歪みが！:
——! ?
Prince, a massive distortion in magical power from Equeon!
m900456.――強き者よ、俺を殺してくれ、って。: ——“Strong one, please kill me,” he's saying.
m900456.――男の友情ってやつぅ？: ――So, that's what brotherhood between men is like, huh?
m900456.――神獣エキーオーン。\nこの世界は、俺たちが守っていく。:
――Equion.
This world is one we will protect.
m900456.……それにしても、\nエキーオーンの最後の表情、見た？:
……By the way,
did anyone else see Equeon's expression at the end?
m900456.……っ！！\n殿下の姿を見た瞬間に、魔力が増大しました！:
……!!
His magical power is surging the moment he sees Your Highness!
m900456.……俺も同意見だ。\nそれほどの誇りを持つ戦士なら、\n暴走し、守るべき世界に仇:
……I agree.
A warrior with that much pride wouldn't want to go berserk
and become a threat to the very world he swore to protect.
m900456.……彼が、そう伝えることを望んだの。\n自分は神獣としては失敗作だからって。:
……He wanted it to be conveyed that way.
Saying he was a failed product as a Divine Beast.
m900456.……神獣エキーオーンの魔力、霧散していきます。\n周囲の墓標の魔力も……。:
……Equion's magical power is dissipating.
The magic in the surrounding monuments is fading, too……
m900456.ああ。\nだからこその、あの表情なんだろうね。:
Ah.
That's exactly why it wore that expression.
m900456.あれは、人生――いや、神獣生か？\nその最後を戦士として終えられた誇りもあるだろ:
It was also pride, I think.
Pride in having ended its life—no, its divine life—
as a warrior, to the very last.
m900456.あれはただの伝説の類で、\n死を怖れる人の感情が生み出した\n創作神話だと思って: I had assumed it was merely a legend, a fictional myth born from the fears of those who feared death……
m900456.いや、それもあるだろうが……。: Well, that's probably part of it, but…….
m900456.えぇっ、そんなに食べられないよ！？: Ehh? I can't eat that much!
m900456.おっ、やっと来たか。\n武具のサイズ直し、終わったか？:
Oh, you're finally here.
Did you finish resizing the armor?
m900456.おや……？\nエキーオーンの魔力は消えたのに、\n剣と鎧だけ、なぜか残っています:
Oh, my……?
Equion's magic is gone, yet
his sword and armor remain for some reason?
m900456.けれど、女神アイギス様がそんな彼らを救ったの。\nスパルトイたちを束ねて、ひとつ:
But Goddess Aigis saved them.
She bound the Spartoi together, made them into a single Divine Beast,
and suppressed their rampaging power.
m900456.ここで、ずっと、自身を打ち倒す戦士が来ることを\n待ち続けていたのですね。:
He has been waiting here, all this time,
for a warrior to come and end his life.
m900456.これからも、彼らの意志を忘れずに、\n歩み続けなければいけませんね……。:
We must keep their will in mind
and continue to move forward…….
m900456.これは……王子、兵に指示を！\nエキーオーンの正面から退避させて！！:
This is… Prince, give the orders!
Pull your troops back from Equeon's front!!
m900456.しばらくは、あの辺りも静かになるだろう。: It should stay quiet around there for a while.
m900456.じゃあ、使わないわけにはいかないわね。: Well then, we'd better put them to use.
m900456.じゃあ、倒しにいかないとか……。\nエキーオーン、どんな力を持った神獣なの？:
So we're just going to leave him alone and…?
What kind of power does Equeon even have?
m900456.じゃなくて……はい、これがエキーオーンの武具だよ。\n身にまとう時は、称号を\n:
I mean…… yes, this is Equeon's armor.
When you equip it, please set the title to
"Bearer of the Undying Will."
m900456.そして女神アイギスに救われ、騎士として\n世界の守護者となった、偉大なるエキーオ:
And then the goddess Aigis saved them, and they became
the world's guardians as knights. The great Equion.
Since the Prince has taken up their cause, their battle lives on.
m900456.そして戦後は、己の力を暴走させないために、\n犠牲となったスパルトイたちと共に、:
And after the war, to prevent his power from going berserk again,
he was sealed on this earth along with the sacrificed Spartoi, if I recall correctly.
m900456.それが、神獣エキーオーン……。: So that is the Divine Beast Equeon……
m900456.ただ、正確にこの時代に伝わっていない事実があって――: However, there is one fact that has not been accurately passed down to this era――
m900456.だからこそ、神獣としてではなく、\n共に戦った者としてだけ、\n名を残すことを望:
I see. That's why he wished to be remembered not as a Divine Beast,
but only as one who fought alongside us.
m900456.だが、そのエキーオーンが復活したんだろう？: But that Equeon has awakened, hasn't he?
m900456.では、この武具はおふたりにお任せしますね。: In that case, I'll leave these weapons to the two of you.
m900456.ところが、半分は作り話じゃないのよ。: But it turns out half of it isn't fiction.
m900456.とても、安心した様子が伝わってきました。\n王子と出会ったことで、\n任せられる:
It looked so… relieved.
I wonder if it felt like someone it could entrust its fate to
now that it had met the Prince?
m900456.ねぇ、何だか苦しそうじゃない？: Hey, doesn't he look like he's in pain?
m900456.はい、今の彼は失敗作ではない、\n完全な神獣ですからね。:
Yes. He is no longer a flawed creation;
he is a complete Divine Beast.
m900456.はい。\n報告によれば、魔力の暴走は感じられるものの、\nまだ封印地点から動き出:
Yes.
According to reports, we can sense a surge in magical power,
but he has not yet moved from the sealing site.
m900456.ははっ、悪い悪い。\nそれじゃ、さっそく王子に見せてやってくれよ。:
Haha, my bad, my bad.
Well then, go show it to the Prince right away.
m900456.ふっふっふ、そうなると思って待機してたよー？: Fu-fu-fu, I knew this would happen and was just waiting around~?
m900456.ふふん、ご褒美はおいしいごはんでお願いね。\nキャラットちゃんと一緒に十人前くら:
Hehe, I expect a delicious meal as a reward.
About ten servings, with Carat-chan and all.
m900456.やっとじゃないよー！\nミスリアちゃんたちだから、この速度で出来たんだけどなー！:
"Finally"?!
It's only because it's us that we could get it done this fast, you know!
m900456.よろしくお願いします。\nそれでは王子、我々は拠点へ戻りましょうか。:
We'll leave it in your hands.
Now then, Prince, let's head back to the base.
m900456.わぁ、騎士鎧だ！\nこれは腕がなるなぁ♪:
Whoa, knight's armor!
This is going to be a blast♪
m900456.ん……墓標がまだ残って\n――いえ、これは、剣でしょうか。:
Hm…… the monuments are still there, but
――no, is that a sword?
m900456.ん……神獣なのにアンデッドなの？\nそれに、人類のために戦ってくれたなら、\n偉:
Hm…… A Divine Beast, yet undead?
And if it fought for humanity, I'd think it would be remembered as a great Divine Beast……
m900456.エキーオーンが、神獣だということですね。: That Equeon is a Divine Beast.
m900456.エキーオーンがアンデッドであること、\n千年戦争で人類に味方したことは、紛れもな: Equeon being undead, and having sided with humanity in the Millennium War, are both undeniable facts.
m900456.エキーオーンと言えば、\n千年戦争で人類に味方した、強大なアンデッドだったか？: If it's Equeon, I recall it was a powerful undead that sided with humanity during the Millennium War?
m900456.エキーオーンの魔力に引き寄せられた魔物が\nまだ近くにいるかもしれないしね。:
There might still be monsters nearby,
drawn in by Equion's magical power.
m900456.エキーオーン封印地点、それから周辺の墓地からも、\n集まっていた魔物の大半を駆除:
We've cleared out the vast majority of the monsters
that had gathered at Equeon's sealing site and the nearby graveyards.
m900456.トラムの言っていた必殺の斬撃も、\n常に同じ方向へ撃ったりはしないわ。\n一箇所:
That devastating slash Tram mentioned
won't always strike in the same direction.
If you just keep guarding one spot, you'll get cut down.
m900456.一応言っておきますが、食べ物じゃないですよ？: Just to be clear, it's not food.
m900456.世界を守るために生まれながら、\n世界を害する者になった彼らは、死を望んでいまし: Born to protect the world, they became its destroyers, and they wished for death.
m900456.世界を守るために生み出され、\nそれすら叶わないと絶望した彼ら……。:
They were created to protect the world,
yet they fell into despair when even that became impossible……
m900456.世界を守るために生み出されたのが神獣ですから。\n同じ意志を持つ王子だからこそ、:
Divine beasts were created to protect the world.
It's precisely because the Prince shares that same will
that they leave their power behind for him.
m900456.今にも暴走しそうな力を、\n必死に抑え込んでいるのでしょう。:
He is desperately holding back
the power that is on the verge of running wild.
m900456.千年戦争の時の記憶のとおりなら、\n付近の墓標が、それぞれの力を司っているはずよ:
According to my memories of the Millennium War,
the monuments nearby should be governing each of his powers.
We'll need to destroy them, or our attacks won't get through.
m900456.対魔王の決戦に備えた量産個体でしたが、\nその全ての個体が暴走……。:
They were mass-produced individuals prepared for the decisive battle against the Demon King,
but all of them went berserk……
m900456.形見、ではないでしょうか？\n王子が使命を受け継いでくれたから、\nその力になる:
Perhaps they are mementos.
Since the Prince has accepted their mission,
they may have left their weapons behind to lend him their strength.
m900456.彼は確か、合成されたスパルトイたちの権能を、\nそのまま受け継いでいたかと。:
I believe he inherited the abilities
of the Spartoi that were fused into him.
m900456.戦士として生み出された神獣だから、\n戦況を読む力にも長けているわ。:
Since he was created as a warrior,
he's also adept at reading the battlefield.
m900456.戦士の矜持、と言うべきでしょうか。\n己が守るべき世界を、人々を傷つけないように:
It must be a warrior's pride.
Trying not to hurt the world and the people he is meant to protect…
m900456.手練れの戦士を相手にするつもりで挑め、ということだな。\nあとは、神獣ならば「神:
So, we need to approach this as if we're facing a seasoned warrior.
Also, as a Divine Beast, he should possess the “Radiance of the Gods,” right?
m900456.暴走する神獣ではなく、誇り高き戦士のまま、\nそして己の使命を託せる男の手で死ん:
It didn't die as a rampaging beast, but as a proud warrior.
And it died in the hands of a man it could entrust its mission to.
That must have been what both Equeon and Spartoi wanted.
m900456.本来なら戦うことなく葬られたはずのスパルトイたち。\nその意志が込められているの:
These are the Spartoi who were originally meant to be buried
without ever fighting.
Their will is woven into it.
m900456.永遠に己を封じているつもりが、\n目覚めて、暴走しそうになっている。\nそれなら:
He intended to seal himself away forever,
but he has awakened and is on the verge of going berserk.
If that's the case, the Divine Beast Equeon must surely be wishing for this.
m900456.王子、お前は拠点で休むといい。\n周辺の調査はヴァンパイアハンターで進めておこう:
Prince, you should rest at the base.
We'll proceed with the surrounding survey as Vampire Hunters.
m900456.王子、此度の神獣エキーオーン討伐も、お疲れ様でした！: Well done, Prince. You've worked hard subduing the divine beast Equion!
m900456.眠りについていたスパルトイたちも、\n神獣エキーオーンも、これで安心して眠れるわ:
The Spartoi who were sleeping,
and Equion himself, can finally rest in peace.
m900456.確か、姿を隠す権能に、魔法への耐性、\n強靭な防御を誇る鎧に、\n一直線に駆け抜:
If I recall, he had the ability to hide his form, resistance to magic,
armor boasting impenetrable defense,
and a powerful slash that cuts straight through… something like that.
m900456.神獣たち、王子を同類だと勘違いしてるんじゃないか？\n気に入られすぎだろ。:
I'm starting to think the divine beasts mistake the Prince for one of their own.
He's becoming too popular.
m900456.神獣エキーオーンの魔力を帯びた斬撃です！\nとにかく受け止めないようにしてくださ:
That's a slash imbued with Equeon's divine power!
Do whatever it takes to avoid taking a hit!!
m900456.神獣エキーオーンは、量産に失敗した、\n戦士型の神獣スパルトイの集合体です。: The Divine Beast Equeon is a collective of warrior-type Divine Beast Spartoi that failed in mass production.
m900456.禍々しい……というより、\nどこか冷たさを感じる武具だな。:
It's not so much ominous as……
it feels somewhat cold, doesn't it?
m900456.絶望と、誇りと、守護者の意志。\n王子はまた、大変なものを託されたわね。:
Despair, pride, and the will of a guardian.
The Prince has been entrusted with quite the burden again.

m920002.おそらく竜人は魔物の復活に呼応したに\n間違いないでしょう。: It's almost certain the dragonfolk are responding to the monsters' resurgence.
m920002.さあ、ご指示をお願いいたします。: Now then, I await your orders.
m920002.さらに長く生きた個体は\n高い知能を持つといわれています。\n非常に手ごわい相手: Moreover, the older individuals are said to have high intelligence—truly formidable opponents.
m920002.そのため、魔物がやぶられてからは\nわずかな生き残りは地底深くに身を潜めて\nい: So after the monsters were driven back, the few survivors apparently took refuge deep underground.
m920002.ただし、一体ずつの戦闘力は\n人間の比ではありません。: However, each one's combat power is far beyond that of a human.
m920002.並外れた力を持ち、全身を\n強固な鱗に覆われています。: They possess extraordinary strength and their bodies are covered in tough scales.
m920002.伝承によれば、竜人はかつての千年戦争では\n魔物の軍勢として戦ったと言われていま: Legend says the dragonfolk fought as a horde of monsters during the previous Millennium War.
m920002.王子、ご挨拶が遅れましたこと\n誠に申し訳ありません。: Prince, I sincerely apologize for the delay in greeting you.
m920002.私はアリア、今回の『竜人の侵攻』の\n防衛戦の補佐をアンナ様より命じられました。: I am Aria. Lady Anna has tasked me with assisting in the defense against the “Dragonfolk Invasion.” First, let me explain the dragonfolk.
m920002.竜人は長寿ですが繁殖能力が低く\n個体数は多くありません。\n人数でいえば我々が: Dragonfolk live long lives but reproduce slowly, so their numbers aren't great. In sheer count, we have the advantage.

m920217.……あまりビーチを荒らさぬようにな。: ……Just try not to wreck the beach, alright.
m920217.……あらゆる智慧を力業で打ち砕いて来た蛮勇。\n絶対的優位を塵芥のように踏み躙る:
……Brute force that shatters all wisdom.
The very incarnation of injustice, trampling absolute superiority like dirt.
m920217.……あーもう！ どうなっても知らねぇからな！: ……Ugh, fine! I don't care what happens!
m920217.……ったく、ようやく一息付けそうか？: ……Hmph. I thought we'd finally get a breather.
m920217.……なるほど理由は理解したが、\nそれでも密漁していい理由にはならないな。: ……I understand the reason, but that does not justify poaching.
m920217.……なんだか、普通に平和で楽しいな。\nグルメジャングルって名前にビビりすぎたか:
……This is actually pretty peaceful and fun.
Did I get too worked up over the name "Gourmet Jungle"?
m920217.……ほう、スイカ割りか。面白い。\nだが、この面子でやるには少し簡単すぎるか？:
……Hm, watermelon cutting, is it? How amusing.
But for a group like us, it might be a bit too easy.
m920217.……まあ、そうなりますわよね。: ……Well, I suppose that was to be expected.
m920217.……グレーターデーモンさん。\nどうして密漁なんて真似をしたんですの？: ……Greater Demon. Why would you do something like poach?
m920217.……ワシにも譲れない理由があってね。\n悪いけれど、全力で抵抗させてもらうよ。: ……I have my reasons for not backing down. Forgive me, but I will resist with all my might.
m920217.……ワシも過去には一次産業に従事した身、\n漁師たちの苦悩は理解しているつもりだ: ……I, too, worked in primary industry in my day. I believe I understand the fishermen's plight.
m920217.……分かりました、私が間に立ちます。\n密漁のことをちゃんと謝ってから、\nそれ: ……Very well, I will mediate. Apologize properly for the poaching, and then negotiate through proper channels.
m920217.……大きな嵐の予感がします。\n皆さん、急いで拠点まで退避を！:
……I sense a great storm approaching.
Everyone, evacuate to the base immediately!
m920217.……大丈夫ですの？\nなんだか急に不安になってきたのですけど。:
……Are we really okay?
I suddenly feel quite uneasy.
m920217.……我々の知るグルメジャングルは、\nこの不可思議の孤島の一部に過ぎない。: ……The Gourmet Jungle we know is merely a fraction of this mysterious island.
m920217.……確かに、いきなりだと怪しい話に聞こえますね。: ……Indeed, coming out of the blue, it would sound suspicious.
m920217.……経験上、タダより高いものはありませんわ。: ……From experience, there is no such thing as a free lunch.
m920217.……言い残すことはあるか。: ……Is there anything you wish to say before it's over?
m920217.……闇の組織の幹部が、コソコソとスイカ泥棒とはな。\n海の漢を名乗りながらよくも:
……Officer of a dark organization, sneaking around stealing watermelons.
How can you call yourself a man of the sea and sink so low?
m920217.──いえ、もう交戦の意思はないようです。: —No, it seems he has no intention of fighting anymore.
m920217.──やあ、王国諸君。楽しんでいただけているかな？: ──Hello, everyone from the Kingdom. Are you enjoying yourselves?
m920217.──敵襲！ 敵襲！ 魔獣が施設内に侵入したぞ！: Enemy attack! Enemy attack! Magic beasts are breaching the facility!
m920217.あ、いや、お嬢さん、これはだな……。: Ah, no, miss, this is actually……
m920217.あ、みなさん分かってるとは思いますけどー。\nグルメジャングルの魔獣たちは高級食:
Ah, I know everyone understands, but—
The magical beasts in the Gourmet Jungle are high-end ingredients, so
please try to take them down cleanly, if possible.
m920217.ああ、任せとけよ。一か所に集まってくれんなら余裕だ。: Yeah, leave it to us. If they're all gathered in one place, it's a piece of cake.
m920217.あいつもスイカ食いたかっただけかよ！？: So he just wanted a watermelon too?!
m920217.あたしはてっきりまたあの知的風眼鏡が、\n何かやらかしやがったのかと思ってたが…: I figured that intellectual-looking pair of glasses was up to something again, but…
m920217.あの方、またストレスが加速しそうですねぇ。: I suppose his stress levels are accelerating again.
m920217.ある！ すっごいある！: Yes! I really, really want some!
m920217.あれはジャイアントアノマロカリスさんですわね。\n今ではこの近辺でしか見られない: That is a Giant Anomalocaris. It is a rare crustacean that can now only be found in this area, and──
m920217.あー、これを機に六次産業化したり？: Oh, maybe this is the chance to pursue the sixth industry?
m920217.いいえ、導きの星はこう言っています。\n『絶対に面白いことになるから行け』と。:
No, the Star of Guidance says this.
It says, "It will absolutely be fun, so go."
m920217.いいや、この場では力を借りてしまったが、\n諸君もまた我々が守るべき宿泊客に変わ:
No. While I appreciate the offer,
you are guests in our care just like the rest of them.
We can't put you in any more danger than this—
m920217.いえいえ、心配することはありませんよ。\n確かに何かの前振りのようにも聞こえます:
Oh, please, there is no need to worry.
It certainly sounds like some sort of foreshadowing, but—
m920217.いつの間にそんなもん造ってたのか……。\nそんで、何処にあるんだそのリゾートは？:
When did they build something like that……?
And where is this resort, anyway?
m920217.いや、追う必要はないだろう。\nスイカの十や二十は渡してやってくれ、\n今はそれ:
No need to chase them.
Just let them have ten or twenty watermelons.
There is something far more important to deal with right now.
m920217.いやぁ、何でもありですねぇ！: Well, I suppose anything can happen!
m920217.いやー、むしろかなり仲が良いんじゃないですか？\n普段、私たちの前では英傑をして:
No, I think they get along quite well, actually.
They always put on a heroic front in front of us, after all.
m920217.うむ、この我の見立てによれば、\n魔獣たちに統率された動きはない。:
Mm. According to my assessment,
the beasts are not moving in a coordinated manner.
m920217.うむ、これでようやく魔獣の侵攻も止むだろう。\n結局、諸君には最後まで迷惑を掛け:
Mm. With this, the beast invasion should finally cease.
In the end, I've been a burden to you all right up to the last.
m920217.うむ、優雅さの欠片もない暴れっぷり。\n女王とは何かを考えさせられる光景だな。:
Mm, a truly undignified display of rage.
It makes one ponder what it means to be a queen.
m920217.うむ、我等も伊達にシェフを名乗っているわけではない。\n王国の料理人たちが優秀な:
Mm. We do not take the title of Chef lightly.
I have already heard that the kingdom's cooks are quite skilled, but…
m920217.ええ、まずは漁師の方と交渉するのが先では？: Yes, you should negotiate with the fishermen first, don't you think?
m920217.ええ、デモシェフ商会から王国の皆様へ、とのことで。\n新しく建設されたリゾート施:
Yes, it's from the Demon Chef Trading Company, addressed to everyone in the Kingdom.
We've been given complimentary passes to their newly built resort facility.
m920217.えっ、密漁！？ こんな堂々としてるのに！？: Illegal fishing?! Even though he's being so open about it?!
m920217.お、おう。さっさとホテル戻れよな。: O-Oh. Yeah. Head back to the hotel already.
m920217.かなりの大群みたいですね。\nグルメジャングル中の魔獣さんたちが、\nリゾートに:
It looks like a massive swarm.
It seems all the magic beasts in the Gourmet Jungle
are heading straight for the resort.
m920217.ぐぬぬ……どうして今になって魔獣が暴走を……。: Grrr... Why are the magic beasts rampaging now of all times...
m920217.これは……大地が、鳴いている……？: This is… the earth is groaning…?
m920217.ご苦労。聞いたな皆の者、ここが正念場である。\n魔獣たちを叩き、このリゾート地を:
Well done. Listen up, everyone. This is the decisive moment.
We must strike down the magical beasts and defend this resort at all costs.
m920217.さて、偶にはシェフらしいこともせねばな。\n諸君、スイカのジェラートに興味はない:
Now then, a chef should do something befitting his title from time to time.
How about some watermelon gelato, everyone?
m920217.しかし、そのスイカの美味しさが仇となった──: However, the deliciousness of that watermelon became our downfall—
m920217.しようとしたとも、だけど門前払いを受けてね。\n大切なアノマロカリスを悪用させる: I tried, but I was turned away at the door. They said they couldn't let me misuse their precious Anomalocaris. My past reputation has caught up with me, it seems.
m920217.すごいな、驚くほど気勢が削がれたぞ。\nこの生理的嫌悪もあの男の作戦なのか？:
Impressive. Their morale has taken a serious hit.
Is this visceral repulsion part of that man's strategy, too?
m920217.すまん……どうか無茶だけはしてくれるな。\n危なければいつでもホテルに退避するよ:
I'm sorry... just please don't do anything reckless.
If things get too dangerous, retreat to the hotel immediately.
m920217.せっ、戦略的撤退と言ってもらいてぇところだなァ……！\nこんな馬鹿げた島に手下を:
L-Let's call it a strategic retreat, alright……!
We can't just send our minions into this ridiculous island!
m920217.そうか？ 被害者がそう言うのなら構わんが……。: Is that so? If the victim has no objection, I suppose it's fine…
m920217.そうだとしたら他の商会からの妨害工作とか？\n手広く事業をやってるから競合とか多: Could it be sabotage from another company? They're in a lot of businesses, so they probably have plenty of rivals.
m920217.そうですね、今は魔獣の対処の方が先です。\n残りのスイカを集めて、早急に動きまし:
Indeed. We should prioritize dealing with the magical beasts.
Let's gather the remaining watermelons and move quickly.
m920217.そうね、何か対策を立てないと。\nこのままだといつか限界が来るわ。: You're right. We need to come up with a plan. At this rate, we'll eventually hit our limit.
m920217.そう思うんならこの後の待遇には期待してんぜ？\nどんだけ豪華なメシが出てくるんだ:
If you feel that way, then you'd better expect some top-tier treatment afterward.
I can't wait to see how lavish the meal is going to be.
m920217.そう気にすんな、こんなんいつものことだろ？\n美味い飯の前のちょっとしたアトラク:
Don't worry about it. This is just a regular Tuesday for us.
Think of it as a little pre-dinner show.
m920217.そこは企業秘密だ。時期が来れば教えよう。: That's a trade secret. I'll tell you when the time is right.
m920217.そのためには大量のスイカが必要だ。\n皆の者、急ぎスイカの回収作業に移れ。:
To do that, we need a massive amount of watermelons.
Everyone, hurry and begin the retrieval operation.
m920217.そのアノマロカリスさんたちを密漁しようなんて、\n漁師さんたちの苦労を何だと思っ: To think you'd try to poach them! What do you think of the fishermen's hard work?!
m920217.その割には駒の動かし方が稚拙であろうよ。\n我ならばより効率的にリゾートを破壊で: If so, the execution was rather clumsy. I could have destroyed the resort far more efficiently.
m920217.その意気や良し。であれば斬られても文句はないな？: I admire the spirit. If you insist, I suppose you can't complain if I cut you down?
m920217.それが叶うんならすげぇんだけどなぁ……。: If they can pull that off, that'd be awesome, though……
m920217.それだ。いいねぇ、楽しそうじゃねぇか。: That's the spirit. Sounds like fun.
m920217.それは賢い選択だけど、泥棒は見過ごせないよね。\n悪いことばっかしてると嘘つきに:
That was a smart choice, but I can't just ignore the theft.
If you keep doing bad things, you'll end up becoming a liar, you know?
m920217.そんなこと誇られてもなぁ。: That's not exactly something to brag about.
m920217.そんな意地悪な言い方しなくていいじゃん。\n正義の味方は困ってる人を見捨てないも:
You don't have to be so mean about it.
Heroes don't just walk away from people in trouble!
m920217.だが、その上で宣言させてもらおう。密漁をすると。: But hear me out. I am going to poach.
m920217.だが、デモシェフたちは張り切っていたぞ。\nいつも世話になっている王子たちを歓待:
But the Demon Chefs were very enthusiastic.
They want to host the Princes who always help them out.
Isn't it too cruel to reject such good intentions?
m920217.だが、我々には宿泊客を守る義務がある！\n誰かを見捨てることなどあってはならない:
But we have a duty to protect our guests!
We can't just leave anyone behind!
m920217.だがあの威容、かつての汝を彷彿とさせるな。: But that imposing presence reminds me of you in your prime.
m920217.だけど、急にどうして魔獣が暴れ出したのかしら。\nデモシェフ商会に手落ちはなさそ: But why did the monsters suddenly start rampaging? I don't think the Demoshef Company made any mistakes, though...
m920217.ちょいと不敬が過ぎるだろうよ。: ……a bit too disrespectful, wouldn't you say?
m920217.ちょっと大きいだけのお猿さんに、\n純粋な暴力で負けるはずがありません。:
There's no way we'd lose to a giant ape
just because it's big and violent.
m920217.ですが、もしもあなたの誠意が相手方に伝われば、\n一匹ぐらいは融通してもらえるか: However, if your sincerity reaches them, they may be willing to make an exception for one.
m920217.では、逃げ遅れた方々は私たちの方で請け負いましょう。: Then we'll take care of the ones who are still behind.
m920217.でも、旅費も何も全部負担してくれるってよ？: But they're covering all the travel costs and everything, you know?
m920217.でも本当は親近感が湧いちゃってたり？: But maybe you feel a sense of kinship?
m920217.というか、襲ってきた魔獣たちもさー、\n最初からスイカが目的だったんじゃない？:
Actually, the demon beasts that attacked us earlier—
weren't they after the watermelons all along?
m920217.ともかく、一先ず拠点に戻りませんか？\n襲撃がこれで終わりとは思えないですし。: In any case, shouldn't we head back to base for now? I doubt this was the end of the attacks.
m920217.どうか我々にお任せを、それが今できる最善です。: Please, leave it to us. This is the best we can do right now.
m920217.どっちが強ぇか、殴り合いで決めるとしようや。: Let's settle this with a fistfight and see who's stronger.
m920217.なにかさりげなーく良識派ぶってますけど、\nやっぱり素があれだと無理がありますよ:
Oh, you're trying so hard to sound reasonable,
but it's hard to ignore your true nature, isn't it?
m920217.なるほど……海巫女の加護を活かした海中遊泳とは、\n確かにこれは新時代のレクリエ: I see... Swimming underwater with the blessing of a sea witch. This truly can be called a recreation of the new era.
m920217.なるほど──ッ！？ 気を付けろ！\nバルバロス・マグヌスが起き上がるぞ！:
I see—!? Watch out!
Barbaros Magnus is getting up!
m920217.なんにせよ、安全さえ確保すりゃ良いリゾートだ。\nそろそろ遅れてる連中も合流する:
Either way, it's a great resort as long as we're safe.
Those who are running late should be catching up by now.
m920217.ばっかオメェ、これが船長の素に決まって──: You idiot, this is just the captain's true self, obviously—
m920217.ひとまず宿泊客の避難誘導から始めましょう。\nこうなっては休暇などと言ってもいら:
Let's start by guiding the guests to evacuate.
There's no more time for a vacation now.
m920217.ふっ、決まりのようですね。\nこれもまた星の導きと言えるでしょう。\nええ、星が:
Heh, it seems settled.
This, too, can be called the guidance of the stars.
Yes, the stars are telling us to go!
m920217.ふふ、お気遣いありがとうございます。\nですが、この程度の陽光であれば問題ありま:
Hehe, thank you for your concern.
But this amount of sunlight is no problem for me.
m920217.ふふふ、案ずるな。我に秘策がある。: Heh heh. Don't worry. I have a secret plan.
m920217.ふむ……話は平行線のようですね。: Hmm……it seems we're at an impasse.
m920217.ふむ、では我々で二つのチームに分かれて、\nどちらが多くスイカを割れるか競うのは:
Hm, then how about we split into two teams
and see which side can cut more watermelons?
m920217.ふーむ、中々面白い試みだ、ゆっくり楽しむといい。\nそれじゃあワシは行くよ、邪魔: Mm, quite an interesting endeavor. Enjoy it to the fullest. Well, I'm off. Sorry for the intrusion.
m920217.ほーん、根性あるじゃねぇか。\nそれなら次は立てなくなるまで──:
Hmph, he's got some grit, I'll give him that.
Well then, next time I'll keep him down until—
m920217.まあ、最後まで何事もないことを祈るとするか。:
Well, I guess I'll just pray nothing goes wrong until the end.
--- scene: Ancient Species Attack (battle, start) ---
m920217.まあまあ、少し落ち着いてください。\n確かに古代種の登場は予想外でしたが、\nこ:
Now, now, let's keep our composure.
It's certainly unexpected to see an Ancient appear,
but we have our own share of trouble on this side.
m920217.まさか、まだ立ち上がるのか……？\n古代種というのは随分とタフなんだな。:
No way, is he still able to rise?
Ancients are remarkably tough, aren't they.
m920217.まさかあのスイカがデモシェフの手作りだとはなぁ。: I never expected that watermelon to be a handmade creation of the Demon Chef.
m920217.またお前んとこの眼鏡が何かしたんじゃないのか？: Could it be that one of your glasses-wearing types did something again?
m920217.まだ見ぬグルメジャングルの向こう側には、\nあれに匹敵する存在が複数いるとのこと:
Apparently, there are several beings on the other side of the Gourmet Jungle
that rival him in power…
m920217.まっ、誰が悪いって話でもねぇな。\n強いて言うならデモシェフの運か。:
Well, it's not anyone's fault, really.
If I had to blame someone, it's Demon Chef's luck.
m920217.むむっ！ このスイカ美味しいですよ！？: Mmph! This watermelon is so tasty!
m920217.もういいよ！ もういいから戦おうや！: Enough already! Enough of this, let's just fight!
m920217.もう走り回らなくてもいいのは助かるな。\n所詮は数だけの寄せ集め、容易い相手だ。:
It's a relief I don't have to run around anymore.
They're just a mob of numbers. Easy prey.
m920217.もう逃げ遅れた宿泊客はいないみたいですね。: It looks like all the guests who were behind have been accounted for.
m920217.よーし、お前らジャンジャン集めてけー。\n帰りの駄賃だ、ありったけ持って帰る──:
Alright, you guys, grab as many as you can.
It's your pay for the trip, so take everything you can carry──Oh.
m920217.よーし分かった。まずはお前からお星さまにしてやる。: Alright, I get it. I'll start by knocking you out.
m920217.わぁ、大きなスイカですね！: Oh my, that's a big watermelon!
m920217.わー！？ わー！？ 殺しちゃダメですよー！？: Waaah?! Waaah?! Don't kill him, please!
m920217.ん……待って、何か聞こえない？: Hm… wait, can't you hear that?
m920217.んん？ 君たちは王国……ではなく帝国かな？\nこんなところで会うとは奇遇じゃない: Hm? You are from the Kingdom... or is it the Empire? What a coincidence, meeting you here.
m920217.アワレ！ アワレ！ サスガニアワレ！: Poor thing! Poor thing! Truly a pitiful sight!
m920217.インテリデーモンなら別件の対応中です、\nこのリゾートには一度も来ておりません。:
The intellectual demons are handling a separate matter.
They have not set foot in this resort even once.
m920217.オレのハートは深く傷ついたァ！\nってことでこのスイカは頂いていくぜェ！\nお前:
My heart is deeply wounded!
So, I'm taking this watermelon!
You guys, grab one each and make off with it!
m920217.ギャギャ！ イタイ！ イタイ！ アッチイケ！: Gyagyaa! It hurts! It hurts! Go away!
m920217.ギャギャ！ オサナイ！ カケナイ！ シャベラナイ！: Gyagyaa! Don't be naughty! Don't run! Don't talk!
m920217.クールでミステリアスな伝説の占星術師ですがー？？: I'm a cool and mysterious legendary astrologer, you know??
m920217.グ、グレーターデーモン？ 何故ここに……？: G-Greater Demon? Why are you here...?
m920217.グルメジャングルにも慣れたものだ。\nこれだけの面子が集まれば勝利は固い。:
I've grown accustomed to the Gourmet Jungle.
With this lineup, victory is assured.
m920217.グルメジャングルに適応した料理というものを教えよう。: I shall teach you how to cook for the Gourmet Jungle.
m920217.グルメジャングルの、真の王が……。:
The true king of the Gourmet Jungle…
--- scene: Barbarian King VS Barbaric Valor ---
m920217.グルメジャングルの王者とも事前に交渉をし、\nセキュリティ体制は万全に整えてあり:
We have already negotiated with the King of the Gourmet Jungle,
and our security measures are in perfect order.
m920217.グルメジャングルの魔獣たちを刺激せぬように、\nこれまでどれほど細心の注意を払っ: How much care we've taken to avoid provoking the Gourmet Jungle's magic beasts...!
m920217.グルメジャングルは理より外れた孤島。\n皆様の安全性に対する懸念はもっともですが:
The Gourmet Jungle is an isolated island that defies reason.
Your concerns about safety are well-founded, and we are fully aware of the risks involved.
m920217.シェフ！ 施設内に逃げ遅れた宿泊客が！: Chef! There are guests who didn't make it out of the facility!
m920217.ジャイアントアノマロカリスさんは、\n全身がとある難病の薬になるんです。: The Giant Anomalocaris is a cure for a certain rare disease. Its entire body can be used as medicine.
m920217.ジャイアントアノマロカリスさんは絶滅危惧種ですのよ！\n近隣の漁師の方々の献身的: The Giant Anomalocaris is an endangered species! Thanks to the dedicated conservation efforts of the local fishermen, the population has only just begun to recover recently…
m920217.テメェら、見損なうんじゃねぇ！\n船長は前々からこのリゾート地を狙ってたがなァ、:
Don't you dare look down on us!
Our captain had been targeting this resort for ages, but
the local conditions turned out to be way too sketchy, so we had to wait for a better time!
m920217.デカ猿、お前もやらかしちまったなァ。\nあたしの前で野蛮なる王を名乗んのは──:
Big Ape, you've really messed up this time, haven't you?
Calling yourself the Barbaric King in front of me is—
m920217.デケぇな……今までどこに隠れてやがったんだ？: Big guy… where have you been hiding all this time?
m920217.デモシェフか……まあ、思ったより悪くはねぇな。: Demon Chef……Well, it's not as bad as I expected.
m920217.トゥアンよ、我は同じ女王として恥ずかしいぞ。: Tuan, as a fellow queen, I am deeply ashamed.
m920217.トンチキ星占いが何か言ったかァー！？: Did that Nonsense Star-Reader just say something?!
m920217.ハッ、見つかっちまったもんは仕方がねェ！\n悪党だろうが、嘘つきだろうが上等じゃ:
Hah, well, if you've caught us, there's nothing we can do!
Being a villain or a liar is fine by me!
Being chased by a cute little girl isn't so bad either!
m920217.ハッハァッ！ 及ばねぇなァ！？: Hah-haah! You can't keep up with me, can you?!
m920217.ハハハ、スイカなら余るほどある。\nおかわりも遠慮せずしてくれたまえ！:
Hahaha, we have plenty of watermelons to spare.
Please, help yourselves to seconds!
m920217.ハハハ、心配無用、これは魔界産ではない。\n少し特別だが、物質界産の美味しいスイ:
Hahaha, don't worry. This one isn't from the Demon Realm.
It's a bit special, but it's a delicious watermelon from the Material World.
m920217.バルバロス・マグヌスまで出てきたときは、\nさすがの私も内心では少し焦りましたよ:
When Barbalos Magnus appeared,
even I was a little shaken inside, I must admit.
m920217.フォローになってねぇぞオイ！？: That's not following the story at all, you idiot!
m920217.フッ……ボロボロだぜ、身も心もな……。: Hah…… I'm a wreck, body and soul……
m920217.フハハハハ！ そうだろう、そうだろう！\nここはデモシェフ商会の総力を結集して建:
Fuhahaha! I knew it, I knew it!
This is a brand-new, large-scale complex resort facility, built with the full might of the Demon Chef Trading Company!
m920217.フルーツポンチもご用意できますよ。: We can prepare fruit punch as well.
m920217.リゾート施設内の安全確保のために、\nグルメジャングルの王者との交渉を行った際、:
When we negotiated with the ruler of the Gourmet Jungle to ensure
safety within the resort facility,
the magical beasts remembered the taste of the watermelon we brought.
m920217.レジャーは楽しく、食事は美味しく。\n愉快で快適な旅行体験を約束するとも。:
Leisure is fun, and the food is delicious.
I promise you a pleasant and comfortable travel experience.
m920217.ワオ！ ユーアーグレートソルジャー！: Wow! You are a great soldier!
m920217.ワシはジャイアントアノマロカリス漁の途中でね。\n君たちはダイビングか、デモシェ: I was in the middle of my Giant Anomalocaris hunt. Are you diving? Is this provided by the Demoshef Company?
m920217.ワシを、許すと言うのかい……？: You… are willing to forgive me?
m920217.一度だけ、ジャングルにまで姿を現したことがある。\nそのとき、目撃者は奴をこう呼:
It has only once manifested itself as far as the jungle.
At that time, the witnesses called it this—
m920217.上空から岩をぶつけることで獲物を弱らせ、\n巣に運んで食べてしまう凶悪なドラゴン:
They're vicious dragons that weaken their prey by dropping rocks from the sky,
then carry them back to their nests to eat.
m920217.上等な品ですわね、産地をお訊ねしても？: It's a fine specimen, indeed. May I ask where it's from?
m920217.乱獲され個体数が激減したのも、\nそれが原因だったはずですわ。: That is likely why overfishing caused the population to plummet in the first place.
m920217.事前に海水で冷やしておいたスイカが、\n騒動の余波で海に流れてしまったのです。\:
The watermelons we had chilling in the seawater
ended up washed out during the commotion.
……So we just need to retrieve all of them, right?
m920217.今回はデモシェフ商会の気合が窺えますねぇ。\n本気でグルメジャングルを物質界でも:
You can really feel the Demon Chef Trading Company's dedication this time.
They might be seriously trying to turn the Gourmet Jungle into a top-tier resort in the Material World.
m920217.今朝収穫したばかりの新鮮なスイカです。\nこちらでスイカ割りなどどうかと思いまし:
It was harvested fresh this morning.
I thought we might try our hand at watermelon cutting.
m920217.仕方ねぇ、避難完了までの時間稼ぎだ。: I guess we have no choice. We'll just have to buy time until the evacuation is done.
m920217.何でも星占いのせいにできると思うなよ！？: Don't you dare blame everything on the stars!
m920217.先にそれを言え！ アイツら連れ去られるぞ！: Say that first! They're going to get them off with them!
m920217.全然元気じゃねぇか！？: He doesn't look even a little tired!
m920217.出来立てのリゾート地に来てるぐらいですからねー。\nゴブリンの中でもかなりの富裕:
Well, they are staying at a brand-new resort.
They might be part of the goblin upper class.
That probably means they have a bit more education and refinement than the average goblin.
m920217.分かりました、私も前に出ますので、\n辛くなったらすぐに言ってくださいね？:
Understood. I'll take the front line, so
please tell me right away if it gets too tough, okay?
m920217.副デーモンシェフ、持ってきてくれたか。: Deputy Demon Chef, you brought it, did you?
m920217.勝って、食って、気持ちよく寝るぞ！: Let's win, eat, and get some well-earned rest!
m920217.千年戦争を戦い抜いた者にしか分からない、\n彼女たちだけの特別な絆があるのでしょ:
There must be a special bond between them
that only those who have fought the Millennium War can understand.
m920217.向こうの者たちを見てみよ。\nせっせとスイカを回収しておる。\n汝らも見習って早:
Look at the others over there.
They are diligently retrieving the watermelons.
You should follow their example and get to work──
m920217.周囲を巻き込んで今回の大規模侵攻に発展したと。: And it escalated into this large-scale invasion, dragging the surroundings into the chaos.
m920217.味は聞いてないぞ。: I haven't heard anything about their taste.
m920217.善意だから余計厄介だってんだよ！: It's precisely because it's good intentions that it's troublesome!
m920217.喧嘩しないの。そろそろ次の波が来るわよ。: No fighting. The next wave is coming.
m920217.大丈夫かよ、カカオみてぇに暴れねぇだろうな。: You sure it's safe? It's not gonna go wild like that cocoa, right?
m920217.大丈夫ですか？ 日射しが強いようですけど……。: Are you alright? The sun seems quite intense...
m920217.大口の顧客から依頼があったんだよ。\nジャイアントアノマロカリスが欲しいとね。\: I received a request from a major client. They wanted a Giant Anomalocaris. Apparently, they intend to use it to treat their daughter.
m920217.奴らを餌で釣って進路を誘導し、\n集まったところを一網打尽にする。:
We will lure them with bait to guide their path,
then wipe them all out once they gather.
m920217.実際、多少のトラブルは想定していましたが、\n今のところその気配もなく快適そのも: I did anticipate a few hiccups, but so far, it's been nothing but smooth sailing.
m920217.導きの星もそれ見たことかと爆笑していることでしょう。: The Star of Guidance is probably laughing its head off at the sight of all this.
m920217.待って、ただでさえ魔獣の侵攻が激しいってのに、\nここで二手に分かれちゃあ各個撃:
Wait, the magic beast invasion is already intense enough.
If we split up here, we'll just get picked off one by one.
m920217.待て、あれは我が社の従業員ではないぞ？: Wait, those are not our employees?
m920217.後生ですから嵐雨はおやめください。:
Please, for the sake of the facility, no storms.
--- scene: Ancient Species Attack (battle, end) ---
m920217.心意気は立派だが、実力が伴わねぇとな。\n無理なら無理と言うのも勇気の一つだぜ。:
That's a noble sentiment, but it's useless without the skill to back it up.
Knowing when to back down is a kind of courage, too.
m920217.急いで警備員を向かわせろ！\n怪我人が出る前に避難を完了させるのだ！:
Send the security guards immediately!
Get the evacuation finished before anyone gets hurt!
m920217.悠長に話している場合ではないだろう！\nあんなものが暴れたらリゾートは滅茶苦茶だ:
We don't have time for small talk!
If that thing goes on a rampage, the resort will be destroyed!
We should begin evacuating off the island immediately!
m920217.意外とそうでもないのかもしれんぞ。\n実際、スイカは純粋に美味しいのだし。:
It might not be that simple.
After all, the watermelon was genuinely delicious.
m920217.慰安旅行も合同演習もいつもの場所でいいだろ。\nわざわざ見えてる地雷を踏みに行く:
A company trip or a joint exercise can just happen at the usual place.
There's no reason to deliberately step on a landmine we can see coming.
m920217.我々レベルになると気配で場所が分かるからな。\n目隠し程度では大した問題にはなら:
At our level, we can sense where it is just by the aura.
A blindfold wouldn't pose much of a challenge.
m920217.手羽先の唐揚げが美味しい翼竜だ！\n甘辛いタレに絡めると実に美味だぞ！:
They're pterodactyls with delicious fried wing tips!
Coating them in a sweet and spicy sauce makes them absolutely divine!
m920217.散れ散れ！ 誰が行くんだよそんな厄ネタ！\n絶対にロクなことにならねぇって分かる:
Scatter, scatter! Who's going to such a cursed place?
You know it's bound to go wrong!
m920217.新鮮な高級食材もたんまりとありますからねー。\n魔界の寵児の手腕、とことん見せて:
We have plenty of fresh, high-end ingredients, too.
I can't wait to see the full extent of the Demon Chef's skills.
m920217.日頃のストレス解消のために始めた家庭菜園が、\nグルメジャングルの土壌と化学反応:
I started a home garden to relieve my daily stress, and it
had a chemical reaction with the soil of the Gourmet Jungle…
m920217.未だかつて誰一人としてその全容を知らぬ彼の地には、\n古代より姿を変えずに生きる:
No one has ever known the full extent of that place.
It is said that giant beasts have lived there unchanged since ancient times.
m920217.本来ならばここはグルメアイランドとでも言うべき土地。\nしかし、そう呼ばれていな:
Properly speaking, this land should be called the Gourmet Island.
However, there is a good reason it is not known by that name.
m920217.極めて卑劣で低俗な手ですが、効果的な戦術かと。\nやはり闇の組織の幹部、中々の策:
It is an extremely despicable and vulgar tactic, but an effective one.
As expected of a high-ranking member of a dark organization, he is quite the strategist.
m920217.残りの夏は、ゆっくり過ごせそうでなによりだ。: I'm glad we can spend the rest of the summer at our leisure.
m920217.気持ちは分からないでもないですけどね。\nこのスイカ、とんでもなく美味しいですし:
I can't say I don't understand.
These watermelons are incredibly delicious.
m920217.決してジャングルの向こうには行ってはいけない。\nそこは、人類の生存圏から大きく:
You must never go beyond the jungle.
That is a land of death, far removed from the sphere of human survival.
m920217.海にいっぱいスイカが浮いてますー！: There's a ton of watermelons floating in the sea!
m920217.海中ではいつも戦ってばかりでしたからね、\nたまにはこういうのも新鮮で良いと思い: We are always fighting underwater, after all. It's nice to do something fresh like this once in a while.
m920217.王子殿下には改めて感謝しませんと。\n我々もリゾートに誘っていただけて──: We must thank Your Highness once again. We were even invited to the resort──
m920217.皆様、この度はデモシェフ商会プレゼンツ。\n人魚のスキューバダイビングにようこそ: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Mermaid Scuba Diving, presented by the Demoshef Company~♪
m920217.礼はいいから早く建物に入れ！\n連れて行かれても知らねぇからな！:
Save the thanks and get inside the building!
I'm not responsible if they take you!
m920217.移れじゃねぇよ、お前も集めんだよ。: Don't tell me to "begin it," you're supposed to help gather them too.
m920217.結局、このスイカはどこで仕入れたんですの？\nどうやら貴重な代物というのは分かり:
Where on earth did you get these watermelons from?
I can tell they're quite rare, but…
m920217.縁を切れそんな星。: Cut ties with a star like that.
m920217.義理人情と損得勘定、どちらも重要です。\nゆえにどちらが正しいということもありま:
Both obligation and self-interest are important.
Therefore, neither can be said to be entirely correct.
In that case, let's leave the decision to our representative.
m920217.脳が理解を拒否するワードだぜ……。: My brain is refusing to process that word...
m920217.自分たちが狩る側だと思ってる馬鹿共に、\n年季の違いってやつを教えてやるとするか:
Let's teach these fools who think they're the hunters
the difference between a rookie and a veteran.
m920217.船長ォ！？ ひでぇ、奴ら鬼かよ！？: Captain!? Ugh, are those guys demons or what!?
m920217.蛮王……ってことはトゥアンの親戚？: The Barbarian King… so is he Tuan's relative?
m920217.蛮王──バルバロス・マグヌス。\nその拳を受けて立っていられる者はいないと。:
The Barbarian King—Barbalos Magnus.
No one can stand before its fists.
m920217.許すかどうかを決めるのは漁師の方々ですわ。\n私たちはただ、謝罪の場を設けるだけ: It is up to the fishermen to decide whether to forgive you. We are merely providing a chance to apologize.
m920217.転んで怪我しないように気を付けて！: Be careful not to fall and get hurt!
m920217.陽気なゴブリンたちが襲われているぞ！\n見たことのないタイプのドラゴンだ！:
The cheerful goblins are under attack!
They're a type of dragon I've never seen before!
m920217.頑張ってこの島の天気を嵐にしちゃいますので！: I'm going to work hard to turn this island's weather into a storm!
m920217.食べたいですー！: I want to eat that too!
m920217.食べ過ぎ厳禁ですからねー。\nあなた減量終わってないでしょ？:
Now, now, no overeating.
You haven't finished your diet, have you?
m920217.馬鹿な！？ 施設の警備体制は完璧なはず……！: What nonsense?! Our security protocols are supposed to be flawless...!
m920217.馬鹿め、我は女王であるぞ？\n頭脳労働担当に決まっているであろう。:
Fool. I am a queen.
It is obvious that my role is mental labor.
m920217.魔獣たち、スイカに釣られ順調に集まっています。\nもう間もなく接敵する予想です、:
The magical beasts are taking the bait and gathering smoothly.
We expect contact soon. All units, prepare to intercept.
m920217.魔獣たちは一度知ったスイカの味を忘れられず、\nジャングルの王者の制止を振り切っ:
Unable to forget the taste of the watermelon they had once known,
the beasts ignored the ruler's warnings and went on a rampage.
m920217.魔獣の大群、来ます！: A massive horde of magical beasts is coming!
m920217.（……グルメジャングルより王国の方が危険では──？): (……Is the Kingdom actually more dangerous than the Gourmet Jungle?)
m920217.（こいつが自信満々のときって、\nなんかちょっと不安なんだよなー）: (When he gets that confident look on his face, it actually makes me a little nervous...)
m920217.（なんとも惨めですが……不思議と惹かれませんねぇ……）: (It's quite a sorry state of affairs…… yet strangely, I find myself drawn to it……)
m920217.（やはり誠心誠意か……。\n結局のところ商売で一番大事なのは、\n『心』なのかも:
(So it really does come down to sincerity……
In the end, the most important thing in business
might just be having a good "heart"……)

m920220.……そういえば群青姉妹は？: ……Oh right, what about the Indigo Sisters?
m920220.……そうですね、今は快復を待ちましょう。: ……Yes, let's wait for her to recover for now.
m920220.……なんか、思ったより爽やかに終わったな。: ……Huh, that ended more smoothly than I expected.
m920220.……ふぅ、あの子もまだまだみたいね。帰るわよ。: ……Hmph. That child still has a long way to go. Let's go.
m920220.……ふっ、大丈夫なのですか？\n修道会の異端審問官ともあろう御方が、\n神の御業:
……Hm. Are you alright?
As the Inquisition Officer of the Order,
you should not speak as if doubting the work of God.
m920220.……アイネさん、すごく落ち着いた方ですね。\n戦神マレスの無茶振りに少しも動じて:
……Aine-san, you're remarkably calm.
You don't seem the least bit rattled by War God Mares' outrageous requests.
m920220.……心当たりはいくつかありますが、\n憶測でものを言うのはやめておきましょう。\:
……There are a few possibilities,
but let's not jump to conclusions.
We'll hear her side of the story once she wakes up.
m920220.……金糸雀か紫苑呼んでこよっか？: ……Should I go call for the Golden Nightingale or the Aster?
m920220.──そこまで、勝者は王国の王子！: ──That's enough. The winner is the Prince of the Kingdom!
m920220.──それで、団長の容体は？: And how is the Captain doing?
m920220.──アイネ、決勝の相手はどんなやつなんだ？: ──Aine, who are we up against in the finals?
m920220.──ッ、分かったよ！ やりゃあいいんだろ！？: —Got it! You want me to fight, right?!
m920220.──二試合目の挑戦者を発表しましょう。: ──Let us announce the challenger for the second match.
m920220.──師から受け継ぎし我が奥義を見よ！: Behold the secret art I inherited from my master!
m920220.──待っていたぞ、王国の戦士たちよ。: ──I've been waiting for you, warriors of the Kingdom.
m920220.──我が名はゴブリン王子、小鬼の未来を照らす者なリ。: ──I am the Goblin Prince, the one who illuminates the future of the goblins.
m920220.──改めて、此度の司会進行を務めるアイネと申します。: ──Allow me to introduce myself once more. I am Aine, your host for this event.
m920220.──早く行け！ 長くは保たんぞ！: Hurry! I can't hold out much longer!
m920220.──時間です、最初の挑戦者を紹介しましょう。\n彼こそは魔界の冬を担う者、キング:
──The time has come. Let us introduce the first challenger.
He is the one who bears the winter of the Demon Realm: the King of Snowmen.
m920220.──有象無象と宿命付けられ、\nこの世に生まれた者たちがいた。:
──There were those born into this world,

doomed to be labeled as mere nobodies.
m920220.『…………フッ』じゃねーのにゃ。\n絶対そんなこと考えてないのにゃよ。:
It's not like he was “Heh”ing on purpose.
He definitely wasn't thinking about that at all.
m920220.『──などと、今頃ウルカノが喚いていることだろう。\nしかしそこは流石の俺様、貴:
『──As I thought, that's probably what Vulcano is yelling about right now.
But of course, I, your humble master, am well aware of your current situation.』
m920220.『かつて物質界連合に敗れた魔王軍の戦士たち。\nしかし、誰よりもお前たちこそが知:
『Once upon a time, the warriors of the Demon King's army were defeated by the Material World Alliance.
But surely, of all people, you know better than anyone.
That as long as the spirit of perseverance shines, the fight is never over.』
m920220.『そこで今回は特別に通常の大会形式ではなく、\n会場を王国近辺に設定した上で、\:
『So, this time, I am making a special exception.
Instead of the usual tournament format,
I have decided to hold it as an exhibition match, with the venue set near the Kingdom!』
m920220.『今回は、貴様がディフェンディングチャンピオンだ！』: 『This time, you are the defending champion!』
m920220.『喜べ戦士たちよ！ 快哉を叫ぶが良い！\n新たな戦神コロッセウムの開催が決定した:
『Rejoice, warriors! Raise a cheer!
The new War God Colosseum has been decided!』
m920220.『来るべき決戦に備える戦士たちの英気と体力を、\n徒に浪費させることは俺様にとっ:
『It is not in my interest to have you waste your vigor and stamina
while preparing for the decisive battle that is to come.』
m920220.『此度のテーマはモンスターズアッセンブル！\n王国に挑むために集まった魔物たちと:
『The theme for this event is Monsters Assemble!
It is a battle against the monsters who have gathered to challenge the Kingdom!』
m920220.『王子よ、かつての敗者にして不撓の挑戦者よ。\n苦難を越え、遥かなる理想へと挑ま:
『Prince, you who were once a loser, yet remain an indomitable challenger.
You who strive to overcome hardship and reach for a distant ideal!』
m920220.あ、喋りが前に戻った。: Ah, his speech pattern is back to normal.
m920220.ああ、以前の職場の同僚だ。\n彼女の身元は私が保証しよう。:
Ah, she was a colleague of mine at my previous job.
I'll vouch for her.
m920220.ああ、新任医官のニーカと申しますー。\n先日学園を卒業したばかりの若輩者ですが、:
Ah, I'm Nika, the newly appointed medic.
I just graduated from the academy not long ago,
so please be kind to me.
m920220.あなた方とて市井の流れる噂や伝聞だけで、\n己という存在を理解されたくはないでし:
Surely you, too, would not wish to be understood
solely through the rumors and hearsay that circulate among the common folk?
m920220.あの魔物はコカトリスでしょう。\nやつのブレスの効果は麻痺と猛毒です。\nまとも:
That monster is a Cockatrice.

Its breath causes paralysis and severe poisoning.

A direct hit could be fatal.
m920220.あんな愉快な醜態を晒した後だ。\nしばらくは大人しくしてるかと思ったが、\n想像:
After putting on such a ridiculous show, I thought he'd keep his head down for a while.
Looks like he's thicker-skinned than I imagined.
m920220.いやぁ、ゴブリンの歴史的瞬間に立ち会えて光栄でした。\nチャムチャムさん、魔猪で:
